All the same, you'll die like humankind, and fall like any one of the princes.
Arise, God, judge the earth — you yourself will take all the nations as your inheritance.

psalms_83.t: A song. A psalm of Asaph.
God, don't keep silence; don't be deaf, don't stay still, God.
Look — your enemies are in an uproar; those who hate you have lifted their heads.
They lay crafty plans against your people, and plot together against the ones you treasure.
They've said, 'Come on, let's wipe them out as a nation, so the name of Israel is never remembered again.'
They've taken counsel with one heart; they're making a covenant against you.
the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre.
Assyria has joined them too; they've become an arm for the sons of Lot. Selah.
Do to them what you did to Midian, to Sisera, to Jabin at the wadi of Kishon,
who were destroyed at En-dor and became dung for the ground.
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
who said, 'Let's take the pastures of God for ourselves.'
My God, make them like whirling dust, like chaff before the wind.
Like fire burning a forest, like a flame setting mountains ablaze —
so pursue them with your storm, terrify them with your storm-wind.
Fill their faces with shame, so they'll seek your name, LORD.
Let them be ashamed and dismayed for ever; let them be abashed and perish,
and let them know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

psalms_84.t: For the choir director. According to the Gittith. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
How lovely are your dwelling places, LORD of hosts!
My being has longed — worn itself out — for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh shout for joy to the living God.
Even the bird has found a home, the swallow a nest for herself, where she's laid her young — your altars, LORD of hosts, my king and my God.
How blessed are the ones who dwell in your house! They go on praising you. Selah.
How blessed is the one whose strength is in you, with the highways in their heart.
Passing through the valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; the early rain covers it with blessings too.
They go from strength to strength; each one appears before God in Zion.
LORD, God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Selah.
Look on our shield, God; attend to the face of your anointed.
One day in your courts is better than a thousand anywhere else. I'd rather stand at the threshold of my God's house than live in the tents of wickedness.
The LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives favour and glory. He doesn't withhold good from those who walk in blamelessness.
LORD of hosts, how blessed is anyone who trusts in you!

psalms_85.t: For the choir director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
You showed favour to your land, LORD; you turned Jacob's captivity around.
You lifted away your people's iniquity; you covered all their sin. Selah.
You withdrew all your fury; you turned back from your burning anger.
Restore us, God of our salvation; put an end to your vexation with us.
Are you going to be angry with us for ever? Are you going to drag your anger out through every generation?
Won't you turn back and give us life, so your people can rejoice in you?
Show us your steadfast love, LORD; give us your salvation.
Let me hear what God the LORD will speak; he'll speak peace to his people and to his loyal ones — but don't let them turn back to folly.
His salvation is near to those who fear him, so that glory may dwell in our land.
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met; righteousness and peace have kissed.
Faithfulness springs up out of the earth; righteousness looks down from the heavens.
The LORD will give what is good, and our land will give its produce.
Righteousness will go ahead of him and make his footsteps a way.

psalms_86.t: Incline your ear, LORD; answer me — I'm poor and needy.
Keep my being — I am loyal. Save your servant, who trusts in you; you are my God.
Be gracious to me, Lord — I call to you all day long.
Make the being of your servant glad — to you, Lord, I lift up my being.
You, Lord, are good and ready to forgive, abounding in steadfast love to everyone who calls on you.
Give ear to my prayer, LORD; attend to the sound of my supplications.
On the day of my distress I call on you, because you will answer me.
There's none like you among the gods, Lord, and no works like yours.
All the nations you have made will come and bow down before you, Lord, and glorify your name.
You're great, and you do wonders; you are God, you alone.
Teach me your way, LORD; I'll walk in your truth. Unite my heart to fear your name.
I'll give you thanks, Lord my God, with all my heart, and glorify your name for ever.
Your steadfast love toward me is great; you've delivered my being from the depths of Sheol.
God, the arrogant have risen against me; a band of the ruthless are after my life, and they haven't set you before them.
But you, Lord, are a God compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness.
Turn to me and be gracious to me; give your strength to your servant; save the son of your maidservant.
Work a sign for me, a good one, so those who hate me will see and be ashamed — because you, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

psalms_87.t: Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song.
He has founded his city on the mountains of holiness.
The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling places of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken of you, city of God. Selah.
I'll make mention of Rahab and Babylon among those who know me. Look — Philistia and Tyre, with Cush: 'This one was born there.'
And of Zion it will be said, 'This one and that one were born in her' — and he himself, the Most High, will establish her.
The LORD will count, when he records the peoples: 'This one was born there.' Selah.
And singers, and dancers alike: 'All my springs are in you.'

psalms_88.t: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choir director. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
LORD, God of my salvation, I've cried out by day, and in the night, before you.
Let my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my cry.
My being has had its fill of troubles; my life has reached Sheol.
I'm counted among those going down to the pit; I've become like a man with no strength,
set loose among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, cut off from your hand.
You've put me in the lowest pit, in dark places, in the depths.
Your rage has lain heavy on me; you've afflicted me with all your breakers. Selah.
You've driven my acquaintances far from me; you've made me an abomination to them; I'm shut in and cannot get out.
My eye grows faint from affliction. I've called on you, LORD, every day; I've spread out my hands to you.
Will you do wonder for the dead? Will the shades rise and give you thanks? Selah.
Will your steadfast love be recounted in the grave, your constancy in Abaddon?
Will your wonder be known in the darkness, your righteousness in the land of forgetting?
But I cry to you for help, LORD; in the morning my prayer comes to meet you.
Why, LORD, do you reject my being? Why do you hide your face from me?
I've been afflicted, close to death since my youth; I've borne your terrors; I am helpless.
Your burning angers have swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.
They surround me like water all day long; they close in on me all at once.
You've driven far from me the one who loves me, and my friend; my acquaintances are darkness.

psalms_89.t: A maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
I'll sing of the LORD's acts of steadfast love for ever; to every generation I'll make known your constancy with my mouth.
For I've said, 'Steadfast love is built for ever; in the heavens you establish your constancy.'
'I've made a covenant with my chosen one; I've sworn to David my servant:
'I'll establish your offspring for ever, and build your throne for every generation.' Selah.
The heavens give thanks for your wonder, LORD, and for your constancy too, in the assembly of the holy ones.
Who in the skies can be ranked with the LORD? Who is like the LORD among the sons of gods?
God is greatly to be dreaded in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those around him.
LORD, God of hosts, who is like you? Mighty is the LORD, and your constancy surrounds you.
You rule the surging of the sea; when its waves rise, you still them.
You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.
The heavens are yours, the earth is yours too; the world and everything in it — you founded them.
North and south — you created them; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at your name.
Yours is an arm with might; your hand is strong, your right hand lifted high.
Righteousness and judgement are the foundation of your throne; steadfast love and faithfulness go before you.
How blessed is the people who know the shout! LORD, they walk in the light of your face.
In your name they rejoice all day long; in your righteousness they are lifted high.
You are the splendour of their strength, and by your favour our horn is lifted high.
Our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
Then you spoke in a vision to your loyal ones and said: 'I've laid help on a warrior; I've raised up a chosen one from the people.
'I've found David my servant; I've anointed him with my holy oil,
'my hand will be steadfast with him; my arm will strengthen him too.
'No enemy will extort from him; no son of injustice will afflict him.
'I'll crush his foes in front of him and strike down those who hate him.
'My constancy and my steadfast love will be with him; in my name his horn will be lifted high.
'I'll set his hand on the sea, his right hand on the rivers.
'He'll call to me, "You are my father, my God, the Rock of my salvation."
'And I'll make him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
'I'll keep my steadfast love for him for ever; my covenant with him will hold.
'I'll set his offspring for ever, his throne like the days of the heavens.
'If his sons forsake my law and don't walk in my judgements,
'if they violate my statutes and don't keep my commandments,
'then I'll punish their transgression with a rod, their iniquity with plagues.
'But I won't break off my steadfast love from him, and I won't be false to my constancy.
'I won't violate my covenant, or change what has gone out from my lips.
'Once and for all I've sworn by my holiness: I will not lie to David.
'His offspring will last for ever, his throne like the sun before me.
'Like the moon it will be established for ever, and the witness in the skies is faithful.' Selah.
But you've spurned and rejected; you've been furious with your anointed.
You've repudiated the covenant with your servant; you've profaned his crown to the ground.
You've broken through all his walls; you've made his strongholds a ruin.
Everyone passing along the road has plundered him; he's become a reproach to his neighbours.
You've lifted high the right hand of his foes; you've made all his enemies rejoice.
You turn back the edge of his sword; you haven't raised him up in the battle.
You've made his lustre cease and thrown his throne to the ground.
You've cut short the days of his youth; you've wrapped him in shame. Selah.
How long, LORD? Are you going to hide yourself for ever? Is your rage going to burn like fire?
Remember how short my lifespan is! For what emptiness you've created all the children of humankind!
What man will live and never see death, who can deliver his own being from the hand of Sheol? Selah.
Where are your former acts of steadfast love, Lord, the ones you swore to David in your constancy?
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants — how I carry in my bosom the insults of all the many peoples,
the insults your enemies have thrown, LORD, the insults they've thrown at the footsteps of your anointed.
Blessed be the LORD for ever. Amen and amen.

psalms_90.t: A prayer of Moses, the man of God.
Lord, you've been our dwelling in every generation.
Before the mountains were born, before you brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.
You return humankind to dust, and you say, 'Return, children of humankind.'
A thousand years in your eyes are like yesterday when it passes, like a watch in the night.
You sweep them away in a flood; they're a sleep; in the morning they're like grass that sprouts up.
In the morning it flourishes and sprouts; by evening it withers and dries up.
We come to an end in your anger; your rage terrifies us.
You've set our iniquities before you, our hidden sins in the light of your face.
All our days pass away in your fury; we finish our years like a sigh.
The days of our years come to seventy years, or by strength, eighty years; and their pride is toil and trouble — it passes quickly, and we fly away.
Who knows the strength of your anger, or your fury, measured against the fear you are owed?
Teach us to count our days, so we can bring a heart of wisdom.
Turn back, LORD — how long? — and have compassion on your servants.
Satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love, so we can shout for joy and rejoice all our days.
Make us rejoice for as many days as you afflicted us, as many years as we saw trouble.
Let your work appear to your servants, your majesty to their children.
Let the kindness of the Lord our God be upon us; establish the work of our hands for us — yes, establish the work of our hands.

psalms_91.t: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will lodge in the shadow of the Almighty.
I say of the LORD, 'My refuge and my stronghold, my God, in whom I trust.'
He'll deliver you from the fowler's snare, from the deadly plague.
He'll cover you with his pinion; under his wings you'll take refuge. His faithfulness is a shield and a wall.
You won't be afraid of the terror of the night, or the arrow that flies by day,
or the plague that walks in the darkness, or the destruction that lays waste at noon.
A thousand will fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand; but it won't come near you.
You'll only look on with your own eyes and see the retribution of the wicked.
Because you've made the LORD — my refuge — the Most High, your dwelling,
no harm will befall you; no plague will come near your tent.
He'll command his angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.
They'll lift you up on their hands, so you don't strike your foot against a stone.
You'll tread on the lion and the cobra; you'll trample the young lion and the serpent.
'Because he's clung to me, I'll deliver him; I'll set him on high, because he knows my name.
'He'll call me and I'll answer him; I'll be with him in distress; I'll rescue him and honour him.
'I'll satisfy him with length of days, and show him my salvation.'

psalms_92.t: A psalm. A song for the day of the sabbath.
It's good to give thanks to the LORD, to make music to your name, Most High,
to declare your steadfast love in the morning, your constancy in the nights,
on the ten-stringed instrument and the harp, to a melody on the lyre.
You've made me rejoice, LORD, by what you've done; at the works of your hands I shout for joy.
How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts run very deep.
A brutish man doesn't know it; a fool doesn't understand this:
that when the wicked flourish like vegetation and all who do wickedness blossom, it's so they can be destroyed for ever.
But you are on high for ever, LORD.
Look at your enemies, LORD — look, your enemies will perish; all who do wickedness will be scattered.
But you've raised my horn like a wild ox's; I've been anointed with fresh oil.
My eye has looked on those who watch me; my ears have heard about the evildoers who rise against me.
The righteous will flourish like the palm, grow tall like a cedar in Lebanon.
Planted in the house of the LORD, they'll flourish in the courts of our God.
They'll still bear fruit in old age; they'll be full of sap and fresh,
to declare that the LORD is upright; he is my Rock, and there's no injustice in him.

psalms_93.t: The LORD reigns; he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed, girded with strength. The world is established too; it will not be shaken.
Your throne is established from of old; you are from everlasting.
The rivers have lifted up, LORD; the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers lift up their pounding.
Above the sound of many waters, majestic are the sea's breakers — and majestic on high is the LORD.
Your testimonies are entirely reliable; holiness befits your house, LORD, for length of days.

psalms_94.t: God of vengeance, LORD, God of vengeance, shine out!
Raise yourself up, judge of the earth; give the proud back what they deserve.
How long will the wicked, LORD — how long will the wicked exult?
They pour out words, they speak arrogance; all who do wickedness boast.
They crush your people, LORD; they afflict your inheritance.
They kill the widow and the sojourner; they murder the fatherless.
And they say, 'The LORD doesn't see; the God of Jacob doesn't perceive.'
Understand, you brutish ones among the people; and you fools, when will you get insight?
The one who planted the ear — doesn't he hear? The one who formed the eye — doesn't he see?
The one who disciplines nations — doesn't he rebuke, the one who teaches humankind knowledge?
The LORD knows the thoughts of humankind — that they're a breath.
How blessed is the man you discipline, LORD, the one you teach from your law,
giving him quiet from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
The LORD won't abandon his people; he won't forsake his inheritance.
Judgement will return to righteousness, and after it all the upright in heart.
Who will rise up for me against evildoers? Who will stand up for me against those who do wickedness?
If the LORD hadn't been my help, my being would soon have dwelt in silence.
When I said, 'My foot has slipped,' your steadfast love, LORD, supported me.
When my disquieting thoughts were many inside me, your consolations delighted my being.
Can a throne of destruction be allied with you — one that fashions mischief by statute?
They band together against the life of the righteous and condemn innocent blood.
But the LORD has become my stronghold, my God the Rock of my shelter.
He's brought their wickedness back on them; he'll destroy them in their own evil — the LORD our God will destroy them.

psalms_95.t: Come, let's shout for joy to the LORD; let's shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.
Let's come before him with thanksgiving; let's shout aloud to him with songs.
The LORD is a great God, a great king above all gods.
In his hand are the depths of the earth; the peaks of the mountains are his.
The sea is his — he made it — and his hands formed the dry ground.
Come, let's bow down and kneel; let's kneel before the LORD our maker.
He is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, the flock of his hand. Today, if only you would listen to his voice —
'Don't harden your heart as at Meribah, as on the day of Massah in the wilderness,
'where your fathers put me to the test — they tested me, though they'd seen my work.
'For forty years I loathed a generation. I said, "They're a people whose heart goes astray; they haven't known my ways."
'so I swore in my anger: They shall not enter my resting place.'

psalms_96.t: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing to the LORD, bless his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.
Recount his glory among the nations, his wonders among all the peoples.
Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; he is to be feared above all gods.
All the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
Splendour and majesty are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
Ascribe to the LORD, clans of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory of his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.
Bow down to the LORD in the adornment of holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.
Say among the nations, 'The LORD reigns. The world is established too; it will not be shaken. He'll judge the peoples fairly.'
Let the heavens rejoice and the earth be glad; let the sea thunder, and everything in it.
Let the field exult, and everything in it; then all the trees of the forest will shout for joy
before the LORD, because he's coming — he's coming to judge the earth. He'll judge the world in righteousness, the peoples in his constancy.

psalms_97.t: The LORD reigns; let the earth be glad; let the many islands rejoice.
Cloud and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and judgement are the foundation of his throne.
Fire goes before him and burns up his foes all around.
His lightning lit up the world; the earth saw and trembled.
The mountains melted like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
The heavens declared his righteousness; all the peoples saw his glory.
Let all who serve a carved image be ashamed, all who glory in worthless idols. Bow down to him, all you gods!
Zion heard and rejoiced; the daughters of Judah were glad, because of your judgements, LORD.
For you, LORD, are Most High over all the earth; you are greatly exalted above all gods.
You who love the LORD, hate evil! He guards the lives of his loyal ones; he delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
Light is sown for the righteous, joy for the upright in heart.
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous; give thanks to his holy remembrance.

psalms_98.t: Sing to the LORD a new song — he has done wonders. His right hand has won him the victory, and his holy arm.
The LORD has made known his salvation; before the eyes of the nations he's revealed his righteousness.
He has remembered his steadfast love and his constancy toward the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Shout aloud to the LORD, all the earth; break forth, shout for joy, and make music.
Make music to the LORD with the lyre — with the lyre and the sound of song.
With trumpets and the sound of the ram's horn, shout aloud before the king, the LORD.
Let the sea thunder, and everything in it, the world and those who live in it.
Let the rivers clap their hands; let the mountains shout for joy together
before the LORD, because he's coming to judge the earth. He'll judge the world in righteousness, the peoples fairly.

psalms_99.t: The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned on the cherubim; let the earth quake.
The LORD is great in Zion; he is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them give thanks to your name — great and to be feared. Holy is he.
The king in his strength loves judgement. You've established equity; judgement and righteousness in Jacob — you have done them.
Exalt the LORD our God; bow down at his footstool. Holy is he.
Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who call on his name; they called to the LORD, and he would answer them.
In a pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and the statute he gave them.
LORD our God, you answered them; you were a God who lifted their guilt away, yet one who avenged their deeds.
Exalt the LORD our God; bow down at his holy mountain — the LORD our God is holy.

psalms_100.t: Shout aloud to the LORD, all the earth.
Serve the LORD with joy; come before him with a shout of joy.
Know that the LORD — he is God. He made us, and we are his, his people, the flock of his pasture.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise; give thanks to him, bless his name.
The LORD is good; his steadfast love is for ever, his constancy to every generation.

psalms_101.t: I'll sing of steadfast love and judgement; to you, LORD, I'll make music.
I'll give attention to a blameless way. When will you come to me? I'll walk in the integrity of my heart inside my house.
I won't set anything worthless before my eyes. I hate the doing of crooked deeds; it won't cling to me.
A perverse heart will turn away from me; I'll have nothing to do with evil.
Whoever slanders his neighbour in secret — him I'll destroy. The haughty of eye, the proud of heart — him I cannot bear.
My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, so they can dwell with me; whoever walks in a blameless way will serve me.
No one who practises deceit will dwell inside my house; no one who speaks lies will stand before my eyes.
Every morning I'll destroy all the wicked of the land, cutting off from the city of the LORD all who do wickedness.

psalms_102.t: A prayer of an afflicted person, when he grows faint and pours out his complaint before the LORD.
LORD, hear my prayer; let my cry for help come to you.
Don't hide your face from me on the day of my distress; incline your ear to me; on the day I call, answer me quickly.
My days have vanished in smoke; my bones are burned like a hearth.
My heart has been struck like grass and has withered; I forget to eat my food.
From the sound of my groaning my bones cling to my flesh.
I'm like a desert owl of the wilderness, like an owl among the ruins.
I lie awake; I've become like a bird alone on a roof.
All day long my enemies have taunted me; those who mock me have used my name as a curse.
I've eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with weeping,
because of your indignation and your wrath — you picked me up and threw me away.
My days are like a lengthening shadow; I wither like grass.
But you, LORD, are enthroned for ever; your remembrance runs through every generation.
You'll arise and have compassion on Zion — it's the time to show her favour; the appointed time has come.
Your servants take pleasure in her stones and show favour even to her dust.
Then the nations will fear the name of the LORD, all the kings of the earth your glory,
because the LORD has built Zion; he has appeared in his glory.
He has turned to the prayer of the destitute and hasn't despised their prayer.
Let this be written for a later generation, and a people yet to be created will praise the LORD.
He has looked down from his holy height; the LORD has looked from the heavens to the earth,
to hear the prisoner's groaning, to set free those under sentence of death,
to recount in Zion the name of the LORD, his praise in Jerusalem,
when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
He has broken my strength along the way; he has cut short my days.
I said, 'My God, don't take me away halfway through my days — your years run through all generations.'
Long ago you founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
They'll perish, but you'll endure; they'll all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you'll change them, and they'll pass away.
But you are the same; your years will not come to an end.
The children of your servants will dwell secure; their offspring will be established before you.

psalms_103.t: Of David.
Bless the LORD, my being; and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
Bless the LORD, my being, and don't forget all his benefits —
who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases,
who redeems your life from the pit, who crowns you with steadfast love and compassion,
who satisfies you with good, so your youth renews itself like the eagle's.
The LORD does acts of righteousness, judgements for all who are oppressed.
He made his ways known to Moses, his deeds to the Israelites.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in steadfast love.
He won't contend for ever; he won't keep his anger for all time.
He hasn't dealt with us according to our sins, or repaid us according to our iniquities.
As high as the heavens are above the earth, that strong is his steadfast love over those who fear him.
As far as the east is from the west, that far has he removed our transgressions from us.
As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
He knows how we're formed; he remembers that we are dust.
As for humankind, his days are like grass; he flourishes like the flower of the field.
The wind passes over it and it's gone, and its place knows it no more.
But the steadfast love of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear him, and his righteousness to children's children,
to those who keep his covenant and remember his precepts, to do them.
The LORD has established his throne in the heavens; his kingdom rules over all.
Bless the LORD, you his angels, mighty in strength, who do his word, listening to the sound of his word.
Bless the LORD, all his hosts, his servants who do his will.
Bless the LORD, all his works, in every place of his dominion. Bless the LORD, my being.

psalms_104.t: Bless the LORD, my being. LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendour and majesty,
wrapping yourself in light like a garment, stretching out the heavens like a curtain,
who lays the beams of his upper rooms on the waters, who makes the clouds his chariot, who walks on the wings of the wind,
who makes winds his messengers, a flaming fire his servants.
He founded the earth on its foundations; it will never be shaken.
You covered it with the deep like clothing; the waters stood above the mountains.
At your rebuke they fled; at the sound of your thunder they hurried away.
The mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place you established for them.
You set a boundary they won't pass; they won't return to cover the earth.
He sends springs into the wadis; they run between the mountains.
They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; from among the foliage they give voice.
He waters the mountains from his upper rooms; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your works.
making grass grow for the cattle, and plants for humankind to cultivate, to bring forth food from the earth,
and wine that gladdens the heart of humanity, oil to make the face shine, and bread that sustains the heart of humanity.
The trees of the LORD are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted,
where the birds make their nests; and the stork — the fir trees are her home.
The high mountains belong to the mountain goats; the rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its setting.
You make darkness, and it becomes night; in it every beast of the forest moves about.
The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
The sun rises; they withdraw and lie down in their dens.
Humankind goes out to work, and labours until evening.
How many are your works, LORD! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
There is the sea, great and wide on every side, with creeping things beyond number, living creatures small and great.
There the ships go about, and Leviathan, whom you formed to play in it.
They all look to you to give them their food at the right time.
You give to them, and they gather it up; you open your hand, and they're satisfied with good.
You hide your face, and they're terrified; you withdraw their breath, and they die and return to their dust.
You send forth your spirit, and they're created; you renew the surface of the ground.
Let the glory of the LORD last for ever; let the LORD rejoice in his works.
He looks at the earth and it trembles; he touches the mountains and they smoke.
I'll sing to the LORD as long as I live; I'll make music to my God while I still am.
May my meditation be pleasing to him; for my part, I rejoice in the LORD.
Let sinners be finished from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my being. Hallelujah.

psalms_105.t: Give thanks to the LORD; call on his name. Make his deeds known among the peoples.
Sing to him; make music to him. Tell about all his wonders.
Take glory in his holy name; let the heart of everyone who seeks the LORD rejoice.
Seek out the LORD and his strength; seek his face always.
Remember the wonders he did — his signs, and the judgements his mouth spoke,
you offspring of Abraham his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He's the LORD our God; his judgements are all over the earth.
He remembers his covenant for ever, the word he commanded, for a thousand generations,
the one he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac,
and he set it up for Jacob as a statute, for Israel as a covenant that lasts for ever,
saying, 'To you I will give the land of Canaan as the share of your inheritance.'
when they were few in number, very few, and sojourners there,
so they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
He allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account:
'Don't touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm.'
He called a famine down on the land and broke every staff of bread.
He sent a man ahead of them: Joseph, sold as a slave.
They hurt his feet with shackles; his neck went into iron.
until the time his word came; the speech of the LORD kept testing him.
A king sent and released him, a ruler of peoples set him free.
He made him master of his household, ruler over all his possessions,
to bind his officials as he pleased, and to teach his elders wisdom.
Then Israel came to Egypt; Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
He made his people very fruitful, stronger than their foes.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal cunningly with his servants.
He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, the one he had chosen.
Among them they performed the words of his signs, and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent darkness and made it dark, and they didn't rebel against his word.
He turned their waters into blood and killed their fish.
Their land swarmed with frogs, right into the rooms of their kings.
He spoke, and the swarm came, and gnats through all their territory.
For rain he gave them hail, and flaming fire in their land.
He struck their vines and their fig trees, and broke the trees of their territory.
He spoke, and the locusts came, young locusts beyond number,
and they ate all the vegetation in their land, ate the fruit of their ground.
He struck down every firstborn in their land, the very first of all their vigour.
He brought them out with silver and gold, and among his tribes not one stumbled.
Egypt was glad when they went out — the dread of them had fallen on them.
He spread out a cloud as a covering, and fire to light up the night.
They asked, and he brought quail; he satisfied them with the bread of the heavens.
He opened up a rock and out flowed water; it ran through the dry places like a river.
Because he remembered his holy word, and Abraham his servant.
He brought his people out with joy, his chosen ones with a shout of joy.
He gave them the lands of nations; they took possession of what the peoples had laboured for,
so they would keep his statutes and observe his laws. Hallelujah.

psalms_106.t: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the LORD — he is good; his steadfast love is for ever.
Who can tell the LORD's mighty deeds, or proclaim all his praise?
How blessed are the ones who keep judgement, who do righteousness all the time!
Remember me, LORD, when you show favour to your people; visit me with your salvation,
to look on the good of your chosen ones, to rejoice in the joy of your nation, to glory along with your inheritance.
We have sinned along with our fathers; we've done wrong, we've acted wickedly.
Our fathers in Egypt didn't consider your wonders; they didn't remember the abundance of your acts of steadfast love — they rebelled at the sea, at the Sea of Reeds.
Yet he saved them for the sake of his name, to make his might known.
He rebuked the Sea of Reeds and it dried up; he led them through the deeps as through the wilderness.
He saved them from the hand of the one who hated them, redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
The waters covered their foes — not one of them was left.
Then they believed his words and sang his praise.
They quickly forgot his works; they didn't wait for his counsel.
They craved a craving out in the wilderness and put God to the test in the wasteland.
He gave them what they asked for but sent a wasting disease among them.
In the camp they grew envious of Moses, and of Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
The earth opened and swallowed Dathan, and covered over the company of Abiram.
Fire broke out among their company; a flame burned the wicked up.
They made a calf at Horeb and bowed down to a metal image.
They traded their glory away for the image of an ox that eats grass.
They forgot God their saviour, the one who did great things in Egypt,
wonders in the land of Ham, fearsome deeds down at the Sea of Reeds.
So he said he would destroy them — if Moses his chosen one had not stood in the breach before him to turn back his rage from destroying.
They rejected the desirable land; they didn't believe his word.
They murmured in their tents; they didn't listen to the voice of the LORD.
So he lifted his hand against them, to make them fall in the wilderness,
and to make their offspring fall among the nations, to scatter them among the lands.
They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
They provoked him to anger by their deeds, and a plague burst out among them.
Then Phinehas stood up and stepped in, and the plague was held back.
And it was reckoned to him as righteousness for all generations, for ever.
They provoked wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses on their account,
because they rebelled against his spirit, and he spoke rashly with his lips.
They didn't destroy the peoples, as the LORD had told them,
instead they mixed with the nations and learned their works.
They served their idols, and those became a snare to them.
They sacrificed their own sons and daughters to demons.
They shed innocent blood — the blood of their own sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; and the land was polluted with blood.
They made themselves unclean by their works and played the whore by their deeds.
So the anger of the LORD burned against his people; he abhorred his inheritance.
He handed them over to the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
Their enemies pressed them hard, and they were brought low under their hand.
Time after time he delivered them, but they rebelled in their plans and sank low in their iniquity.
Even so, he saw their distress when he heard their cry of entreaty.
He remembered his covenant for their sake and relented, according to the abundance of his acts of steadfast love.
He gave them over to compassion in front of all their captors.
Save us, LORD our God; gather us from the nations, so we can give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. And let all the people say, 'Amen!' Hallelujah.

psalms_107.t: Give thanks to the LORD — he is good; his steadfast love is for ever.
Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, the ones he redeemed from the hand of the foe
and gathered in from the lands, from east and from west, from north and from the sea.
They wandered in the wilderness, in a trackless waste; they found no city to live in.
Hungry and thirsty, their being fainted away inside them.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their distress, and he delivered them from their troubles.
He led them by a straight way, so they could go to a city to live in.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love, for his wonders to the children of humankind,
because he satisfies the longing throat and fills the hungry throat with good.
Those sitting in darkness and deep darkness, prisoners in affliction and iron,
because they'd rebelled against the sayings of God and spurned the counsel of the Most High.
So he bowed their heart down with trouble; they stumbled, and no one was there to help.
Then they cried aloud to the LORD in their distress, and he saved them from their troubles.
He brought them out of darkness and deep darkness and tore their fetters apart.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love, for his wonders to the children of humankind,
because he has broken gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.
The senseless were afflicted because of the way of their transgression, because of their iniquities.
Their throat loathed all food; they came to the gates of death.
Then they cried aloud to the LORD in their distress, and he saved them from their troubles.
He sent his word and healed them, delivered them from their pits.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love, for his wonders to the children of humankind,
Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and tell of his works with a shout of joy.
Those who go down to the sea in ships, doing their business on the great waters —
they've seen the works of the LORD and his wonders in the deep.
He spoke and raised up a stormy wind that lifted its waves high.
Up to the heavens they went, down to the deeps; their being melted away in the trouble.
They reeled and staggered like a drunkard; all their skill was swallowed up.
Then in their distress they cried out to the LORD, and he brought them out of their troubles.
He hushed the storm to a whisper, and the waves went quiet.
They rejoiced when the waters went quiet, and he guided them to the harbour they wanted.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love, for his wonders to the children of humankind,
and let them exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the seat of the elders.
He turns rivers into wilderness, springs of water into thirsty ground,
a fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the evil of the people living there.
He turns wilderness into a pool of water, dry land into springs of water.
He settles the hungry there, and they establish a city to live in;
they sow fields and plant vineyards and bring in a fruitful yield.
He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; he doesn't let their cattle grow few.
Then they grew few and were bowed down under the pressure of calamity and sorrow.
He pours contempt out on nobles and makes them wander in a trackless waste.
But he sets the needy on high, out of affliction, and makes their families like a flock.
The upright see it and rejoice, and injustice shuts its mouth altogether.
Whoever is wise, let them observe these things and consider carefully the LORD's acts of steadfast love.

psalms_108.t: A song. A psalm of David.
My heart is steadfast, God; I'll sing and make music — my glory too.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I'll waken the dawn.
I'll give you thanks among the peoples, LORD, and make music to you among the nations.
Your steadfast love is great above the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.
So that your beloved may be rescued, save with your right hand and answer me.
God has spoken in his sanctuary: 'I will exult; I will divide up Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.
'Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the protection of my head, Judah my commander's staff.
'Moab is my washing pot; over Edom I throw my sandal; over Philistia I shout aloud.'
Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Edom?
Haven't you rejected us, God? You don't go out, God, with our armies.
Give us help against the foe — human salvation is vain.
With God we'll do valiantly, and he will tread down our foes.

psalms_109.t: For the choir director. Of David. A psalm.
God of my praise, do not be silent,
for the mouth of the wicked and a mouth of deceit have opened against me; they've spoken to me with a lying tongue.
They've surrounded me with words of hatred; they've fought against me without cause.
In return for my love they accuse me, but I am prayer.
They've repaid me evil for good, hatred for my love.
Appoint a wicked man over him, and let an accuser stand at his right hand.
When he is judged, let him come out guilty, and let his prayer count as sin.
Let his days be few; let someone else take his office.
Let his children be fatherless, his wife a widow.
Let his children wander about and beg, seeking far from their ruins.
Let a creditor seize everything he has, and strangers plunder what he laboured for.
Let there be no one to extend steadfast love to him, no one to show favour to his fatherless children.
Let his posterity be cut off; in the next generation let their name be wiped out.
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and let his mother's sin not be wiped out.
Let them be before the LORD continually, and let him cut off their memory from the earth,
because he didn't remember to show steadfast love, but harassed the poor and needy and the disheartened, to put them to death.
He loved a curse, and it came upon him; he didn't delight in blessing, and it stayed far from him.
He put on a curse like his garment; it came like water into his inward parts, like oil into his bones.
Let it be for him like a garment he wraps around himself, like a band he puts on every day.
This is the wage of my accusers from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my life.
But you, GOD the Lord, deal with me for your name's sake; your steadfast love is good — deliver me.
I'm poor and needy, and my heart is pierced within me.
Like a lengthening shadow I've gone; I've been shaken off like a locust.
My knees give way from fasting; my flesh has grown lean, with no fat.
And I've become a reproach to them; they see me and shake their head.
Help me, LORD my God; save me according to your steadfast love,
and let them know that this is your hand, that you, LORD, have done it.
Let them curse — you will bless. They've risen up and been put to shame, but your servant will rejoice.
Let my accusers be clothed with ignominy, wrapped in their shame like a robe.
I'll give thanks to the LORD greatly with my mouth, and praise him in the midst of many.
For he stands at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his life.

psalms_110.t: Declares the LORD to my lord: 'Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.'
The LORD will stretch out the staff of your strength from Zion: 'Rule in the midst of your enemies!'
Your people are freewill offerings on the day of your force; in majesties of holiness, from the womb, before the morning star, I have begotten you.
The LORD has sworn and will not relent: 'You are a priest for ever after the manner of Melchizedek.'
The Lord is at your right hand; he shatters kings on the day of his anger.
He judges among the nations — it's full of corpses; he shatters the head over the wide earth.
He drinks from a wadi by the way; that is why he lifts up his head.

psalms_111.t: Hallelujah. I'll give thanks to the LORD with all my heart, in the council of the upright and in the congregation.
Great are the works of the LORD, studied by all who delight in them.
Splendour and majesty are his work; his righteousness endures for ever.
He has made a remembrance for his wonders; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
He gives food to those who fear him; he remembers his covenant for ever.
He has declared the power of his works to his people, in giving them the inheritance of nations.
The works of his hands are faithfulness and judgement; all his precepts are trustworthy.
They're sustained for ever and ever, done in faithfulness and uprightness.
He sent ransom to his people; he ordained his covenant for ever. Holy and to be feared is his name.
The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the LORD; a good understanding belongs to all who do them. His praise endures for ever.

psalms_112.t: Hallelujah. How blessed is the one who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments!
His offspring will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house; his righteousness endures for ever.
Light rises in the darkness for the upright — he is gracious and compassionate and righteous.
It goes well with the one who shows favour and lends, who conducts his affairs with judgement.
He will never be shaken; the righteous will be remembered for ever.
He won't be afraid of bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
His heart is supported; he won't be afraid, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
He has scattered abroad, he has given to the needy; his righteousness endures for ever; his horn will be lifted high in honour.
The wicked will see it and be angry; he'll gnash his teeth and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

psalms_113.t: Hallelujah. Praise, you servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
May the name of the LORD be blessed, from now on and for ever.
From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the LORD is to be praised.
The LORD is exalted above all nations; his glory is above the heavens.
Who is like the LORD our God, who sets his seat on high,
who stoops down to look on the heavens and on the earth?
He raises the poor from the dust; from the ash heap he lifts up the needy,
to seat him with nobles, with the nobles of his own people.
He gives the barren woman of the house a home, a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah.

psalms_114.t: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,
Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned back.
The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
What is it with you, sea, that you flee? Jordan, that you turn back?
Mountains, that you skip like rams? Hills, like lambs?
Tremble, earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who turns the rock into a pool of water, flint into a spring of water.

psalms_115.t: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love, for the sake of your faithfulness.
Why should the nations say, 'So where is their God?'
But our God is in the heavens; he does whatever he desires.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have a mouth, but don't speak; eyes, but don't see;
ears, but don't hear; a nose, but don't smell;
hands, but don't feel; feet, but don't walk; they make no sound in their throat.
Those who make them will become like them, and everyone who trusts in them.
Israel, trust in the LORD; he is their help and their shield.
House of Aaron, trust in the LORD; he is their help and their shield.
You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; he is their help and their shield.
The LORD has remembered us; he will bless. He will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
He will bless those who fear the LORD, the small along with the great.
May the LORD increase you, you and your children.
Blessed are you by the LORD, maker of the heavens and the earth.
The heavens are the heavens of the LORD, but the earth he has given to the children of humankind.
The dead do not praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence.
But we will bless the LORD from now on and for ever. Hallelujah.

psalms_116.t: I love the LORD, because he hears my voice, my supplications;
because he has inclined his ear to me, I'll call on him as long as I live.
The cords of death surrounded me; the distresses of Sheol found me; I found trouble and sorrow.
And I called on the name of the LORD: 'Please, LORD, deliver my life!'
Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; our God is compassionate.
The LORD guards the simple; I had been brought low, and he saved me.
Return, my being, to your rest, because the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
You've rescued my life from death, my eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.
I'll walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, and so I spoke; I was greatly afflicted.
I said in my alarm, 'Everyone is a liar.'
What can I give back to the LORD for all his benefits to me?
I'll lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
I'll pay my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people.
Precious in the eyes of the LORD is the death of his loyal ones.
Please, LORD — I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your maidservant. You have loosened my fetters.
To you I'll offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and call on the name of the LORD.
I'll pay my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people,
in the courts of the house of the LORD, in your midst, Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

psalms_117.t: Praise the LORD, all nations; extol him, all peoples.
For his steadfast love is strong over us, and the faithfulness of the LORD is for ever. Hallelujah.

psalms_118.t: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his steadfast love is for ever.
Let Israel say: 'His steadfast love is for ever.'
Let the house of Aaron say: 'His steadfast love is for ever.'
Let those who fear the LORD say: 'His steadfast love is for ever.'
From the narrow place I called on the LORD; the LORD answered me in a broad place.
The LORD is for me; I won't be afraid. What can anyone do to me?
The LORD is for me among my helpers, and I'll look in triumph on those who hate me.
It's better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in humankind.
It's better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in nobles.
All nations surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I fended them off.
They surrounded me, they surrounded me on every side; in the name of the LORD I fended them off.
They surrounded me like bees; they were extinguished like a fire of thorns; in the name of the LORD I fended them off.
You pushed me hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
My strength and my might is the LORD; he has become my salvation.
The sound of a shout of joy and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: 'The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!'
The right hand of the LORD is lifted high; the right hand of the LORD does valiantly!
I won't die; I'll live, and I'll recount the works of the LORD.
The LORD has disciplined me severely, but he hasn't given me over to death.
Open to me the gates of righteousness; I'll enter through them and give thanks to the LORD.
This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter through it.
I'll give you thanks, because you answered me; you have become my salvation.
The stone the builders rejected has become the head of the corner.
This has come from the LORD; it is wonderful in our eyes.
This is the day the LORD has made; let's be glad and rejoice in it.
We beg you, LORD, save us now! We beg you, LORD, grant success now!
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD; we bless you from the house of the LORD.
The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the festival sacrifice with cords, right up to the horns of the altar.
You are my God, and I'll give you thanks; my God, I'll exalt you.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his steadfast love is for ever.

psalms_119.t: How blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the LORD.
How blessed are those who observe his testimonies, who seek him with all their heart.
They also do no injustice; they walk in his ways.
You have commanded your precepts, to be kept diligently.
If only my ways were steadfast, so I could keep your statutes!
Then I won't be ashamed when I look to all your commandments.
I'll give you thanks with an upright heart, as I learn your righteous judgements.
I'll keep your statutes; don't utterly forsake me.
How can a young man keep his path pure? By keeping it according to your word.
With all my heart I've sought you; don't let me stray from your commandments.
I've stored up your speech in my heart, so that I won't sin against you.
Blessed are you, LORD; teach me your statutes.
With my lips I've recounted all the judgements of your mouth.
I've exulted in the way of your testimonies as over all wealth.
I'll meditate on your precepts and look to your paths.
I'll delight myself in your statutes; I won't forget your word.
Deal bountifully with your servant, so I may live and keep your word.
Uncover my eyes, so I may look at wonders out of your law.
I'm a sojourner on the earth; don't hide your commandments from me.
My being is crushed with longing for your judgements, always.
You rebuke the arrogant, the accursed, who stray from your commandments.
Roll reproach and contempt away from me; I have observed your testimonies.
Even officials sat and talked against me; your servant meditates on your statutes.
Your testimonies are my delight too — my counsellors.
My being clings to the dust; give me life according to your word.
I recounted my ways and you answered me; teach me your statutes.
Make me understand the way of your precepts, and I'll meditate on your wonders.
My being weeps from grief; raise me up according to your word.
Remove the way of falsehood from me, and grant me your law in favour.
I've chosen the way of faithfulness; I've set your judgements before me.
I've clung to your testimonies; LORD, don't put me to shame.
I'll run the way of your commandments, because you enlarge my heart.
Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes, and I'll observe it to the end.
Make me understand, so I can observe your law and keep it with all my heart.
Lead me in the pathway of your commandments, because I delight in it.
Incline my heart to your testimonies, not to unjust gain.
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthlessness; in your ways give me life.
Fulfil for your servant your speech, which is for the fear of you.
Take away the reproach I dread, because your judgements are good.
See, I've longed for your precepts; in your righteousness give me life.
Let your acts of steadfast love come to me, LORD, your deliverance according to your speech,
and I'll have an answer for the one who taunts me, because I've trusted in your word.
And don't take the word of faithfulness away from my mouth entirely, because I've hoped for your judgements.
And I'll keep your law continually, for ever and ever.
And I'll walk about in a broad place, because I've sought your precepts.
And I'll speak of your testimonies before kings and won't be ashamed.
And I'll delight myself in your commandments, which I love.
And I'll lift up my hands to your commandments, which I love, and meditate on your statutes.
Remember the word to your servant, the one you made me hope on.
This is my comfort in my affliction: your speech has given me life.
The arrogant have mocked me without end; I haven't turned aside from your law.
I remember your judgements from of old, LORD, and I take comfort.
Burning indignation has seized me because of the wicked, who forsake your law.
Your statutes have been songs to me in the house where I sojourn.
I've remembered your name in the night, LORD, and I've kept your law.
This has been mine: that I've observed your precepts.
My portion is the LORD; I've said I'll keep your words.
I've entreated your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your speech.
I've thought about my ways and turned my feet back to your testimonies.
I've hurried and not delayed to keep your commandments.
The cords of the wicked have surrounded me; I haven't forgotten your law.
At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous judgements.
I'm a companion of all who fear you, of those who keep your precepts.
Your steadfast love, LORD, fills the earth; teach me your statutes.
You've dealt well with your servant, LORD, according to your word.
Teach me good discernment and knowledge; I have believed in your commandments.
Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep your speech.
You are good and you do good; teach me your statutes.
The arrogant have smeared me with falsehood; I observe your precepts with all my heart.
Their heart is gross as fat; I delight in your law.
It was good for me that I was afflicted, so I could learn your statutes.
The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands in gold and silver.
Your hands made me and established me; make me understand, so I can learn your commandments.
Those who fear you will see me and rejoice, because I've hoped for your word.
I know, LORD, that your judgements are righteous, and that you afflicted me in faithfulness.
Let your steadfast love comfort me, according to your speech to your servant.
Let your compassion come to me, so I may live; your law is my delight.
Let the arrogant be ashamed — they've wronged me with falsehood; I'll meditate on your precepts.
Let those who fear you turn to me, those who know your testimonies.
Let my heart be blameless in your statutes, so I won't be ashamed.
My being is spent with longing for your deliverance; I've hoped for your word.
My eyes are spent looking for your speech, saying, 'When will you comfort me?'
I've become like a wineskin in smoke; I haven't forgotten your statutes.
How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgement on those who harass me?
The arrogant have dug pits for me, which are not according to your law.
All your commandments are trustworthy; they harass me with falsehood — help me!
They've almost made an end of me on the earth, but I haven't forsaken your precepts.
According to your steadfast love give me life, and I'll keep the testimony of your mouth.
For ever, LORD, your word stands firm in the heavens.
Your constancy runs through every generation; you established the earth, and it stands.
By your judgements they stand this day, because all things are your servants.
If your law hadn't been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
I'll never forget your precepts; by them you have given me life.
I am yours; save me — I've sought your precepts.
The wicked have lain in wait to destroy me; I'll consider your testimonies carefully.
I've seen an end to all perfection; your commandment is exceedingly broad.
How I love your law! All day long it's my meditation.
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies; they are mine for ever.
I have more insight than all my teachers; your testimonies are my meditation.
I gain more understanding than elders, because I've observed your precepts.
I've held my feet back from every evil path, so I can keep your word.
I haven't turned aside from your judgements, because you yourself have taught me.
How sweet your speech is to my palate, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
From your precepts I gain understanding; so I hate every path of falsehood.
Your word is a lamp for my foot, a light for my pathway.
I've sworn and confirmed it: I will keep your righteous judgements.
I've been utterly afflicted; LORD, give me life according to your word.
Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, LORD, and teach me your judgements.
My life is continually in my hand, and I haven't forgotten your law.
The wicked have set a snare for me, but I haven't gone astray from your precepts.
I've taken your testimonies as my inheritance for ever; they are the joy of my heart.
I've inclined my heart to do your statutes, for ever, to the end.
I hate the half-hearted, but I love your law.
You are my hiding place and my shield; I've hoped for your word.
Turn away from me, evildoers, so I can observe the commandments of my God.
Sustain me according to your speech, so I may live, and don't put me to shame in my hope.
Uphold me, so I may be saved, and I'll have regard for your statutes continually.
You reject all who stray from your statutes; their deceitfulness is falsehood.
You put an end to all the wicked of the earth like dross; that is why I love your testimonies.
My flesh trembles from dread of you; I'm afraid of your judgements.
I've done judgement and righteousness; don't abandon me to my oppressors.
Stand surety for your servant for good; don't let the arrogant oppress me.
My eyes are spent looking for your salvation, for your righteous speech.
Deal with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.
I am your servant; make me understand, so I may know your testimonies.
It's time for the LORD to act; they've broken your law.
That is why I love your commandments more than gold, more than pure gold.
So I hold all your precepts right in everything; I hate every path of falsehood.
Your testimonies are wonders; that is why my being observes them.
The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
I opened my mouth wide and panted, because I longed for your commandments.
Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is the judgement for those who love your name.
Direct my footsteps by your speech, and let no wickedness have power over me.
Ransom me from human oppression, and I'll keep your precepts.
Make your face shine on your servant, and teach me your statutes.
Streams of water run down from my eyes, because they don't keep your law.
You are righteous, LORD, and your judgements are upright.
You've commanded your testimonies in righteousness and in great faithfulness.
My zeal has consumed me, because my foes have forgotten your words.
Your speech is thoroughly refined, and your servant loves it.
I'm small and despised; I haven't forgotten your precepts.
Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is truth.
Distress and anguish have found me; your commandments are my delight.
Your testimonies are righteous for ever; make me understand, so I may live.
I've called with all my heart; answer me, LORD; I'll observe your statutes.
I've called on you; save me, so I can keep your testimonies.
I rose early in the twilight and cried for help; I've hoped for your word.
My eyes were awake before the night watches, to meditate on your speech.
Hear my voice according to your steadfast love; LORD, according to your judgements give me life.
Those who pursue wickedness have drawn near; they're far from your law.
You are near, LORD, and all your commandments are truth.
Long ago I learned from your testimonies that you founded them for ever.
See my affliction and rescue me; I haven't forgotten your law.
Plead my cause and redeem me; according to your speech give me life.
Salvation is far from the wicked; they haven't sought your statutes.
Your compassion is great, LORD; according to your judgements give me life.
Many are those who harass me, and my foes; I haven't turned aside from your testimonies.
I saw the treacherous and felt disgust, because they didn't keep your speech.
See that I love your precepts; LORD, according to your steadfast love give me life.
The sum of your word is truth, and every one of your righteous judgements is for ever.
Officials have harassed me without cause, but my heart is in dread at your word.
I exult over your speech, like someone who finds great plunder.
I hate and abhor falsehood; I love your law.
Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous judgements.
Great peace belongs to those who love your law; nothing makes them stumble.
I've waited for your salvation, LORD, and I've done your commandments.
My being has kept your testimonies, and I love them exceedingly.
I've kept your precepts and your testimonies; all my ways are before you.
Let my cry of entreaty come before you, LORD; according to your word make me understand.
Let my supplication come before you; according to your speech deliver me.
Let my lips pour out praise, because you teach me your statutes.
Let my tongue sing of your speech; all your commandments are righteous.
Let your hand be ready to help me; I have chosen your precepts.
I've longed for your salvation, LORD, and your law is my delight.
Let my being live, and it will praise you; let your judgements help me.
I've gone astray like a lost sheep; seek your servant — I haven't forgotten your commandments.

psalms_120.t: I called to the LORD in my distress, and he answered me.
LORD, deliver my life from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
What will he give you, and what more, you deceitful tongue?
A warrior's sharpened arrows, with burning coals of broom wood.
Woe to me, that I sojourn in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
My being has dwelt too long with those who hate peace.
I am peace; but when I speak, they are for war.

psalms_121.t: I lift up my eyes to the mountains: where will my help come from?
My help comes from the LORD, maker of the heavens and the earth.
He won't let your foot slip; the one who guards you won't slumber.
Look — the one who guards Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
The LORD is your guardian; the LORD is your shade at your right hand.
By day the sun won't strike you, nor the moon by night.
The LORD will guard you from all harm; he will guard your being.
The LORD will guard your going out and your coming in, from now on and for ever.

psalms_122.t: A song of ascents. Of David.
I rejoiced when they said to me, 'Let's go to the house of the LORD.'
Our feet have been standing in your gates, Jerusalem.
Jerusalem, built as a city joined firmly together,
where the tribes went up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony to Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
For there the thrones stood for judgement, the thrones of the house of David.
Ask for the peace of Jerusalem: may those who love you be at ease.
May peace be within your rampart, ease within your fortresses.
For the sake of my brothers and my friends I'll say, 'Peace be within you.'
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God I'll seek your good.

psalms_123.t: To you I've lifted up my eyes, you who are enthroned in the heavens.
Look — as the eyes of slaves are to their master's hand, as a female slave's eyes to her mistress's hand, so our eyes are to the LORD our God, until he shows us favour.
Show us favour, LORD, show us favour; we've had more than enough of contempt.
Our being has long been surfeited with the mockery of the complacent, with the contempt of the arrogant.

psalms_124.t: A song of ascents. Of David.
If it hadn't been the LORD who was for us — let Israel say it —
if it hadn't been the LORD who was for us when people rose up against us,
then they'd have swallowed us alive, when their anger burned against us;
then the waters would have overflowed us, a torrent would have swept over us;
then they'd have swept over us — the raging waters.
Blessed be the LORD, who hasn't given us as prey to their teeth.
We've escaped like a bird from the fowlers' snare; the snare was broken, and we escaped.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, maker of the heavens and the earth.

psalms_125.t: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but remains for ever.
As the mountains are around Jerusalem, so the LORD is around his people, from now on and for ever.
The sceptre of wickedness will not rest on the allotted portion of the righteous, so the righteous won't stretch out their hands to do injustice.
Do good, LORD, to the good, and to the upright in their hearts.
But those who turn aside to their crooked ways — the LORD will lead them away with those who do wickedness. Peace be on Israel.

psalms_126.t: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like people dreaming.
Then our mouth was filled with laughter, our tongue with a shout of joy. Then they said among the nations, 'The LORD has done great things for these people.'
The LORD has done great things for us; we were joyful.
Restore our fortunes, LORD, like the stream-beds in the Negev.
Those who sow with tears will reap with a shout of joy.
Whoever goes out weeping, carrying the bag of seed, will surely come home with a shout of joy, carrying his sheaves.

psalms_127.t: A song of ascents. Of Solomon.
Unless the LORD builds a house, its builders toil on it for nothing. Unless the LORD watches over a city, the watchman keeps awake for nothing.
It's in vain for you who rise early, who sit down late, who eat the bread of toil — he gives to his beloved even in sleep.
Look — sons are an inheritance from the LORD; the fruit of the womb is a reward.
Like arrows in a warrior's hand, that is what the sons of one's youth are.
How blessed is the man who has filled his quiver with them! They won't be ashamed when they speak with enemies in the gate.

psalms_128.t: How blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, everyone who walks in his ways.
You'll surely eat the product of your own hands; how blessed you are — it will be well with you.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine inside your house; your children like olive shoots all around your table.
Look — that is how a man is blessed who fears the LORD.
May the LORD bless you from Zion; may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
And may you see your children's children! Peace be on Israel.

psalms_129.t: They've oppressed me long, from my youth — let Israel say it —
they've oppressed me long, from my youth, yet they haven't prevailed against me.
Plowmen have plowed on my back; they've made their furrows long.
The LORD is righteous — he has cut the cords of the wicked.
Let them all be ashamed and turned back, everyone who hates Zion.
Let them be like grass on the roofs, which withers before it's pulled up;
grass no reaper fills his hand with, no sheaf-binder his bosom.
And those who pass by don't say, 'The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.'

psalms_130.t: Out of the depths I've called on you, LORD.
Lord, hear my voice; keep your ears attentive to the sound of my supplications.
If you kept a record of iniquities, LORD — Lord, who could stand?
But forgiveness is with you, so that you may be feared.
I've waited for the LORD; my being has waited; for his word I've hoped.
My being waits for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning — more than watchmen for the morning.
Hope in the LORD, Israel; with the LORD is steadfast love, and with him abundant ransom.
And he himself will ransom Israel from all its iniquities.

psalms_131.t: A song of ascents. Of David.
LORD, my heart hasn't been lofty, my eyes haven't been raised, and I haven't walked among things too great and too wonderful for me.
Surely I've stilled and quieted my being, like a weaned child on its mother; my being within me is like a weaned child.
Hope in the LORD, Israel, from now on and for ever.

psalms_132.t: Remember, LORD, in David's favour all the hardships he endured,
how he swore to the LORD and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
'I won't go into the tent of my house, or climb onto the couch of my bed,
'I won't give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
'until I've found a place for the LORD, a dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob.'
Look — we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
Let's go to his dwelling place; let's bow down at his footstool.
Rise up, LORD, to your resting place — you and the ark of your strength.
Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; let your loyal ones shout for joy.
For the sake of David your servant, don't turn away the face of your anointed.
The LORD swore to David in faithfulness — he will not turn back from it: 'One of the fruit of your body I'll set on a throne for you.
'If your sons keep my covenant and the testimonies I'll teach them, their sons too will sit on a throne for you, for ever.'
For the LORD has chosen Zion; he wanted it for his dwelling.
'This is my resting place for ever; here I'll dwell — I have desired it.
I'll richly bless her provision; I'll satisfy her needy with food.
'I'll clothe her priests with salvation, and her loyal ones will surely shout for joy.
'There I'll make a horn sprout for David; I've prepared a lamp for my anointed.
'I'll clothe his enemies with shame, but on him his crown will shine.'

psalms_133.t: A song of ascents. Of David.
Look how good and how pleasant it is when brothers dwell together!
It's like the good oil on the head, running down on the beard, Aaron's beard, running down on the collar of his robes;
like the dew of Hermon running down onto the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD commanded the blessing — life for ever.

psalms_134.t: Look — bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, you who stand in the house of the LORD at night.
Lift your hands toward the sanctuary and bless the LORD.
May the LORD bless you from Zion — the maker of the heavens and the earth.

psalms_135.t: Hallelujah. Praise the name of the LORD — praise him, you servants of the LORD,
you who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; make music to his name — it's pleasant.
For the LORD chose Jacob for himself, Israel as his own possession.
I know that the LORD is great, and our Lord is above all gods.
Whatever the LORD desires, he does — in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all the deeps.
He brings clouds up from the end of the earth; he makes lightning for the rain; he brings wind out of his storehouses.
the one who struck down Egypt's firstborn, both human and beast;
he sent signs and wonders right into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants;
the one who struck down many nations and killed mighty kings —
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance for Israel his people.
LORD, your name is for ever; LORD, your reputation runs through every generation.
For the LORD will vindicate his people and will have compassion on his servants.
The nations' idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have a mouth, but don't speak; eyes, but don't see;
ears, but don't give ear; and there's no breath at all in their mouth.
The ones who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who trusts in them.
House of Israel, bless the LORD! House of Aaron, bless the LORD!
House of Levi, bless the LORD! You who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
Blessed be the LORD from Zion — the one who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

psalms_136.t: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; for his steadfast love is for ever.
Give thanks to the God of gods, for his steadfast love is for ever.
Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his steadfast love is for ever.
To him who alone does great wonders, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who made the heavens by understanding, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who spread out the earth on the waters, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who made the great lights, for his steadfast love is for ever;
the sun for dominion by day, for his steadfast love is for ever;
the moon and stars for dominion by night, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who struck Egypt through their firstborn, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and brought Israel out from among them, for his steadfast love is for ever;
with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who cut the Sea of Reeds in two, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and made Israel pass through the middle of it, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and shook Pharaoh and his army off into the Sea of Reeds, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who struck down great kings, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and killed mighty kings, for his steadfast love is for ever;
Sihon king of the Amorites, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and Og king of Bashan, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and gave their land as an inheritance, for his steadfast love is for ever;
an inheritance to Israel his servant, for his steadfast love is for ever;
who remembered us when we were brought low, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and tore us free from our foes, for his steadfast love is for ever;
who gives food to all flesh, for his steadfast love is for ever.
Give thanks to the God of the heavens, for his steadfast love is for ever.

psalms_137.t: By the rivers of Babylon — there we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
On the poplars there we hung our lyres up.
For there our captors asked us for the words of a song, and our mockers asked for gladness: 'Sing us one of the songs of Zion!'
How can we sing the LORD's song on foreign ground?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my own right hand forget its skill.
