For the whole lot of them seek their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
But you know what he has proved to be: that like a child with a father, he served as a slave alongside me for the good news.
So I hope to send him the moment I see how things go with me,
and I'm confident in the Lord that I'll be coming myself, soon.
Still, I thought it necessary to send you Epaphroditus — my brother, my co-worker, my fellow soldier, and your envoy and minister to my need.
For he'd been longing for all of you, and he was distressed because you had heard he was ill.
For he was indeed ill — close to death. But God had mercy on him, and not on him only but on me too, so I wouldn't have grief on top of grief.
So I'm sending him all the more eagerly — so that when you see him again you'll rejoice, and I'll be less grieved.
So welcome him in the Lord with all joy, and hold people like him in honour —
because for the work of Christ he came near to death — he gambled with his own life — to make up what was lacking in your service to me.

philippians_3.t: Finally, my brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord. Writing the same things to you is no trouble to me, and it's a safeguard for you.
Watch out for the dogs. Watch out for the evil workers. Watch out for the mutilation.
For we are the circumcision — we who serve by the Spirit of God and boast in Christ Jesus and put no confidence in the flesh,
though I have grounds for confidence in the flesh myself. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh — I have more:
circumcised on the eighth day, from the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew born of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
as to zeal, a persecutor of the community; as to the rightness that is in the law, blameless.
But whatever was gain to me — all of that I have come to count as loss, because of Christ.

More than that — I count everything as loss, because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake I have lost all things, and I count them as rubbish, so that I may gain Christ
and be found in him — not with a rightness of my own that comes from law, but the one that comes through faith in Christ, the rightness from God that rests on trust,
so as to know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the sharing of his sufferings, being formed together with his death,
if somehow I may arrive at the resurrection out from the dead.
Not that I've already received it, or have already been brought to completion — but I pursue it, to see if I can take hold of what I was taken hold of for, by Christ Jesus.
Brothers and sisters, I don't reckon myself to have taken hold of it. But one thing — forgetting what's behind and stretching out toward what's ahead,
I press on toward the mark, for the prize of God's upward call in Christ Jesus.
So all of us who are mature should think this way — and if you think differently about anything, God will reveal that to you too.
Only — as far as we've come, let's walk in line by the same rule and think the same way.
Join in imitating me, brothers and sisters, and watch those who walk the way you have us for a pattern.
For many walk — I've told you about them often, and now I tell you in tears — as enemies of the cross of Christ.
Their end is destruction. Their god is the belly. Their glory is in their shame. They think about earthly things.
For our citizenship exists in the heavens — and it's from there that we eagerly await a Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ,
He'll refashion the body of our lowliness so that it becomes formed like the body of his glory — by the working of his power to subject all things to himself.

philippians_4.t: So then, my brothers and sisters — loved and longed for, my joy and my crown — stand firm in the Lord just like that, beloved.
I urge Euodia, and I urge Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
Yes, and I'm asking you too, true companion — help these women. They contended alongside me in the good news, along with Clement and the rest of my co-workers, whose names are in the book of life.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I'll say it again: rejoice.
Let your reasonableness be known to everyone. The Lord is near.
Don't be anxious about anything — but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God;
and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will stand guard over your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

Finally, brothers and sisters: whatever is true, whatever is honourable, whatever is just, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is well spoken of — if there's any excellence, anything praiseworthy — take all that into account.
What you learned and received and heard and saw in me — do that, and the God of peace will be with you.
I rejoiced greatly in the Lord that now, at last, you've made your concern for me bloom again. You were indeed concerned; you simply had no opportunity.
I'm not saying this because I'm in need; for I have learned to be content in whatever circumstances I'm in.
I know how to be brought low, and I know how to have more than enough. In any and every situation I've been initiated — into being well fed and going hungry, having plenty and going without.
I'm strong enough for all of it in the one who empowers me.
Still, you did well to share with me in my hardship.
You Philippians know it yourselves: at the beginning of the good news, when I left Macedonia, no community entered into partnership with me in the matter of giving and receiving — only you.
for even in Thessalonica you sent for my need more than once.
Not that I'm after the gift — I'm after the fruit that accumulates to your account.
I've been paid in full, and have more than enough. I'm fully supplied, now that I've received from Epaphroditus what came from you — a fragrant aroma, an acceptable sacrifice, pleasing to God.
And my God will fill every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
To our God and Father be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Greet every one of God's people in Christ Jesus. The brothers and sisters with me send their greetings.
All God's people send you greetings — especially those from Caesar's household.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. [To the Philippians, written from Rome by Epaphroditus.]

philemon_1.t: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother — to Philemon, our dear fellow worker,
and to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the community that meets in your house:
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
I always thank my God, mentioning you in my prayers,
hearing about your love, and about the trust you have toward the Lord Jesus and for all God's people —
and I pray that the sharing of your trust may become effective, in a full knowledge of every good thing that is in us, toward Christ.
Your love brought me great joy and encouragement, brother, because you have given God's people rest in their hearts.
So although I have plenty of boldness in Christ to order you to do what you ought,
I would rather appeal to you out of love — being who I am: Paul, an old man, and now a prisoner of Christ Jesus besides.
I'm appealing to you about my own child — the one I became father to while I was in chains — Onesimus,
He was no use to you once; now he's useful to you and to me.
I'm sending him back to you — he is my own heart.
I wanted to keep him here with me, so he could serve me on your behalf while I'm in chains for the gospel;
but I didn't want to do anything without your consent, so that your good deed wouldn't be forced but freely chosen.
Maybe this is why he was separated from you for a while — so that you could have him back forever,
no longer as a slave, but more than a slave: a brother, dearly loved — most of all to me, and how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
So if you count me a partner, welcome him as you'd welcome me.
And if he's wronged you in any way, or owes you anything, put it on my account.
I, Paul, am writing this in my own hand: I'll pay it back — to say nothing of the fact that you owe me your very self besides.
Yes, brother — let me have some use of you in the Lord. Give my heart some rest in Christ.
I write to you confident of your obedience, knowing you'll do even more than I say.
And at the same time, get a guest room ready for me — I'm hoping that through your prayers I'll be given back to you.
Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,
and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke — my fellow workers.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

revelation_1.t: An unveiling of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what has to happen soon — and he signalled it by sending it through his messenger to his servant John,
who testified to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ — everything he saw.
Blessed is the one who reads it aloud, and blessed are those who hear the words of the prophecy and keep what's written in it — because the time is near.
John, to the seven communities in Asia: grace to you and peace from the One who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven spirits before his throne,
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the one who loves us and released us from our sins by his blood
and made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father — to him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
Look — he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him; and all the tribes of the earth will beat their breasts on account of him. Yes. Amen.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end, says the Lord God — the One who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.
I, John, your brother and partner in the persecution and the kingdom and the endurance that are in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard a loud voice behind me like a trumpet
saying: What you see, write in a scroll and send it to the seven communities — to Ephesus and Smyrna and Pergamum and Thyatira and Sardis and Philadelphia and Laodicea.
I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me, and when I turned I saw seven gold lampstands,
and in the middle of the lampstands someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe down to his feet and belted across the chest with a gold sash.
His head and his hair were white like wool, white as snow, and his eyes like a flame of fire,
and his feet like burnished bronze refined in a furnace, and his voice like the sound of rushing water,
and holding seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword coming out of his mouth, and his face like the sun shining at full strength.
When I saw him I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me and said: Do not be afraid. I am the first and the last,
and the living one. I was dead, and look — I am alive forever and ever. And I hold the keys of death and of Hades.
So write what you saw, and what is, and what is going to happen after this —
As for the mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven communities, and the seven lampstands are seven communities.

revelation_2.t: To the messenger of the community in Ephesus write: This is what the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand says — the one who walks among the seven gold lampstands:
I know your works, and your labour, and your endurance, and that you cannot bear people who are evil. You tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and you found them false.
You have endured, and you have carried the load for the sake of my name, and you have not grown weary.
But I have this against you: you have let go of your first love.

So remember where you have fallen from, and change your mind, and do the works you did at first. If you do not, I am coming to you and I will move your lampstand out of its place — unless you change your mind.
But you do have this: you hate what the Nicolaitans do, which I also hate.
Whoever has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the communities. To the one who conquers I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of my God.
And to the messenger of the community in Smyrna write: This is what the first and the last says — the one who was dead and came to life:
I know your affliction and your poverty — but you are rich — and the slander from those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look — the devil is about to throw some of you into prison so that you may be tested, and you will have affliction for ten days. Be faithful to the point of death, and I will give you the crown of life.
Whoever has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the communities. The one who conquers will certainly not be harmed by the second death.
And to the messenger of the community in Pergamum write: This is what the one who has the sharp two-edged sword says:

I know where you live — where Satan's throne is. And you hold on to my name, and you did not deny your trust in me, even in the days of Antipas my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan lives.

But I have a few things against you: you have people there who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a trap in front of the sons of Israel — to eat food sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.
In the same way you also have people who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
So change your mind. If you do not, I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

Whoever has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the communities. To the one who conquers I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written that no one knows except the one receiving it.
And to the messenger of the community in Thyatira write: This is what the Son of God says — the one whose eyes are like a flame of fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze:
I know your works — your love and trust and service and endurance — and that your recent works are greater than the first ones.
But I have this against you: you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet and teaches and misleads my servants into sexual immorality and eating food sacrificed to idols.
I gave her time to change her mind, and she does not want to change her mind about her immorality.
Look — I am throwing her onto a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great affliction, unless they change their minds about what she does.
And I will kill her children with death, and all the communities will know that I am the one who searches minds and hearts, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
But to the rest of you in Thyatira — all who do not hold this teaching, who have not known what they call the deep things of Satan — I say this: I am not putting any other burden on you.
Only hold on to what you have until I come.
And the one who conquers and keeps my works to the end — I will give him authority over the nations,
and he will shepherd them with an iron rod, as clay pots are shattered —
as I also have received from my Father. And I will give him the morning star.
Whoever has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the communities.

revelation_3.t: And to the messenger of the community in Sardis write: This is what the one who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars says: I know your works — that you have a name for being alive, and you are dead.
Wake up, and strengthen what remains, which was about to die — because I have not found your works completed in the sight of my God.
So remember what you received and heard, and keep it, and change your mind. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come to you.
But you have a few names in Sardis who have not defiled their clothes, and they will walk with me in white, because they are worthy.

The one who conquers will be dressed like this, in white clothes, and I will certainly not wipe his name out of the book of life, and I will acknowledge his name before my Father and before his angels.
Whoever has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the communities.

And to the messenger of the community in Philadelphia write: This is what the holy one says — the true one, the one who has the key of David, who opens and no one will shut, and shuts and no one opens:
I know your works. Look — I have put in front of you an open door that no one is able to shut, because you have a little power, and you kept my word and did not deny my name.

Look — I am handing over some from the synagogue of Satan, those who say they are Jews and are not but are lying. Look, I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and know that I have loved you.
Because you kept the word of my endurance, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is coming on the whole inhabited world, to test those who live on the earth.
I am coming quickly. Hold on to what you have, so that no one takes your crown.

The one who conquers — I will make him a pillar in the sanctuary of my God, and he will never go outside again. And I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
Whoever has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the communities.
And to the messenger of the community in Laodicea write: This is what the Amen says — the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God's creation:
I know your works — that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot!
So because you are lukewarm — neither hot nor cold — I am about to vomit you out of my mouth.
because you say: I am rich, I have grown rich, I need nothing — and you do not know that you are the wretched one, the pitiable one, poor and blind and naked.

I advise you to buy from me gold refined by fire so that you may be rich, and white clothes to wear so that the shame of your nakedness is not exposed, and ointment to rub on your eyes so that you can see.
I rebuke and discipline everyone I love. So be earnest, and change your mind.
Look — I am standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.
The one who conquers — I will give him the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I also conquered and sat down with my Father on his throne.
Whoever has an ear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the communities.

revelation_4.t: After this I looked, and there was a door standing open in heaven. And the first voice I'd heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, said: Come up here, and I will show you what has to happen after this.
At once I was in the Spirit, and there was a throne standing in heaven, and someone seated on the throne.
And the one seated looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow around the throne looked like emerald.
Around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and on the thrones I saw twenty-four elders seated, dressed in white clothes, with gold crowns on their heads.
Out of the throne come flashes of lightning and rumblings and thunder. And seven torches of fire burn in front of the throne, which are the seven spirits of God.
And in front of the throne there was something like a sea of glass, like crystal. And in the middle of the throne and around the throne, four living creatures full of eyes in front and behind.
The first living creature was like a lion, the second living creature like an ox, the third living creature had a face like a human face, and the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.

And the four living creatures, each one of them, had six wings, and they are full of eyes all around and inside. And day and night they never stop saying: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, who was and who is and who is coming.
And whenever the living creatures give glory and honour and thanks to the one seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
the twenty-four elders fall down before the one seated on the throne and worship the one who lives forever and ever, and they throw their crowns down in front of the throne, saying:
You are worthy, our Lord and God, the holy one, to receive the glory and the honour and the power — because you created all things, and by your will they existed and were created.

revelation_5.t: And I saw a scroll on the right hand of the one seated on the throne, written on the inside and on the back, and sealed with seven seals.
And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice: Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?
And no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or to look at it.
And I wept a great deal, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to read it or to look at it.
And one of the elders says to me: Do not weep. Look — the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals.

And I saw, in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the middle of the elders, a little lamb standing as though it had been slaughtered, with seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
And he came and took the scroll out of the right hand of the one seated on the throne.

And when he took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each holding a harp and gold bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God's holy people.

And they sing a new song: You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slaughtered, and by your blood you bought people for God from every tribe and language and people and nation,
and you made them a kingdom and priests for our God, and they will reign on the earth.

And I looked, and I heard the sound of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders. And their number was tens of thousands times tens of thousands, and thousands times thousands,
saying with a loud voice: Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered to receive the power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and blessing.

And every created thing in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and on the sea, and everything in them, I heard saying: To the one seated on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing and the honour and the glory and the might forever and ever.
And the four living creatures said: Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.

revelation_6.t: And I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say, with a voice like thunder: Come!
And I looked, and there was a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and to conquer.
And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say: Come!
And another horse went out, fiery red. And to its rider it was given to take peace from the earth, so that people would slaughter one another. And a great sword was given to him.
And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say: Come! And I looked, and there was a black horse, and its rider held a pair of scales in his hand.

And I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures saying: A quart of wheat for a day's wage, and three quarts of barley for a day's wage — and do not damage the olive oil and the wine.
And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say: Come!

And I looked, and there was a pale green horse, and its rider — his name was Death, and Hades was following with him. And authority was given to them over a quarter of the earth, to kill by sword and famine and death and by the wild animals of the earth.
And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slaughtered because of the word of God and because of the testimony they had given.
And they cried out with a loud voice: How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who live on the earth?

And a white robe was given to each of them, and they were told to rest a little longer, until the number of their fellow slaves and their brothers and sisters who were about to be killed, as they had been, was complete.
And I watched as he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake, and the sun turned black like sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became like blood,
and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like a fig tree dropping its late figs when it is shaken by a strong wind,
and the sky was split apart like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
And the kings of the earth and the great men and the commanders and the rich and the strong, and every slave and every free person, hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains,
and they say to the mountains and the rocks: Fall on us, and hide us from the face of the one seated on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb —
because the great day of their anger has come, and who is able to stand?

revelation_7.t: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree.

And I saw another angel coming up from where the sun rises, holding the seal of the living God. And he called out with a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to damage the earth and the sea,
saying: Do not damage the earth or the sea or the trees until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.
And I heard the number of those who were sealed: a hundred and forty-four thousand, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel.
From the tribe of Judah twelve thousand sealed, from the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, from the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,
from the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, from the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, from the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,
from the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, from the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, from the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,
from the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, from the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, from the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand sealed.

After this I looked, and there was a huge crowd that no one could count, from every nation and tribe and people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes with palm branches in their hands.
And they cry out with a loud voice: Salvation belongs to our God, who is seated on the throne, and to the Lamb.
And all the angels were standing around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshipped God,
saying: Amen. The blessing and the glory and the wisdom and the thanksgiving and the honour and the power and the strength belong to our God forever and ever. Amen.
And one of the elders spoke up and said to me: These people dressed in the white robes — who are they, and where did they come from?
And I said to him: My lord, you know. And he said to me: These are the ones coming out of the great affliction, and they washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
That is why they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his sanctuary, and the one seated on the throne will shelter them with his presence.
They will not be hungry any more, or thirsty any more; the sun will not beat down on them, nor any scorching heat,
because the Lamb at the centre of the throne will shepherd them and guide them to springs of living water, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

revelation_8.t: And when he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

And another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a gold censer. And he was given a great deal of incense to offer with the prayers of all God's holy people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
And the smoke of the incense went up with the prayers of God's holy people, from the angel's hand, before God.
And the angel took the censer and filled it with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. And there were thunder and rumblings and lightning and an earthquake.
And the seven angels holding the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.

And the first angel blew his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was thrown on the earth. A third of the earth was burnt up, and a third of the trees were burnt up, and all the green grass was burnt up.
And the second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. And a third of the sea became blood,
and a third of the creatures in the sea that had life died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
And the third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
And the name of the star is called Wormwood. And a third of the waters turned to wormwood, and many people died from the waters, because they had been made bitter.

And the fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them went dark — and the day lost a third of its light, and the night too.

And I looked, and I heard a single eagle flying high overhead, saying with a loud voice: Woe, woe, woe to those who live on the earth, because of the remaining trumpet blasts of the three angels who are about to sound them.

revelation_9.t: And the fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth, and the key to the shaft of the abyss was given to him.
And he opened the shaft of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the shaft like the smoke of a huge furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the shaft.
And out of the smoke locusts came onto the earth, and they were given power like the power that scorpions of the earth have.
And they were told not to damage the grass of the earth or any green plant or any tree, but only the people who do not have God's seal on their foreheads.
And they were not allowed to kill them, only to torture them for five months. And their torture was like the torture of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
And in those days people will look for death and will certainly not find it. They will long to die, and death runs away from them.
And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads were what looked like crowns of gold, and their faces were like human faces,
and they had hair like women's hair, and their teeth were like lions' teeth,
and they had chest armour like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of many horses and chariots charging into battle.
And they have tails like scorpions, and stings; and in their tails is their power to damage people for five months.
They have a king over them — the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he has the name Apollyon.
The first woe has passed. Look — two more woes are still coming after this.
And the sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard one voice from the four horns of the gold altar that is before God,
saying to the sixth angel, the one holding the trumpet: Release the four angels bound at the great river Euphrates.
And the four angels were released — the ones prepared for the hour and the day and the month and the year — to kill a third of humanity.
And the number of the mounted troops was two hundred million; I heard their number.

And this is how I saw the horses in the vision, and those riding them: they had breastplates of fire red and dark blue and sulphur yellow, and the heads of the horses were like lions' heads, and out of their mouths came fire and smoke and sulphur.
By these three plagues a third of humanity was killed — by the fire and the smoke and the sulphur coming out of their mouths.
For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails are like snakes, with heads, and with them they do damage.

And the rest of humanity, the ones not killed by these plagues, did not change their minds about the works of their hands. They would not stop worshipping the demons and the idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
And they did not change their minds about their murders or their drugs or their sexual immorality or their thefts.

revelation_10.t: And I saw another strong angel coming down out of heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with the rainbow over his head, and his face like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
And he was holding in his hand a little scroll, opened. And he set his right foot on the sea and his left on the land.
And he shouted with a loud voice, like a lion roaring. And when he shouted, the seven thunders spoke with their own voices.
And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; and I heard a voice from heaven saying to me: Seal up what the seven thunders said, and do not write it.
And the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven
and swore by the one who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and what is in it and the earth and what is in it and the sea and what is in it: There will be no more delay.
But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be completed, as he announced to his servants the prophets.
And the voice I had heard from heaven spoke with me again and said: Go, take the scroll that is open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.
And I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. And he says to me: Take it and eat it up. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.
And I took the little scroll from the angel's hand and ate it up, and in my mouth it was sweet as honey — and when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.
And they say to me: You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and languages and kings.

revelation_11.t: And I was given a measuring rod like a staff, and I was told: Get up and measure the sanctuary of God and the altar, and those worshipping in it.
But leave out the courtyard outside the sanctuary; do not measure it, because it has been given to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months.
And I will give my two witnesses authority, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, dressed in sackcloth.
These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
And if anyone wants to harm them, fire comes out of their mouth and consumes their enemies. And if anyone should want to harm them, that is how he must be killed.

These have the authority to shut the sky so that no rain falls during the days of their prophesying, and they have authority over the waters to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.
And when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them and will conquer them and kill them.
And their corpse will lie on the main street of the great city — the city that is called, spiritually, Sodom and Egypt — where their Lord was also crucified.
And for three and a half days, people from the peoples and tribes and languages and nations look at their corpses, and they do not allow their corpses to be put in a tomb.
And those who live on the earth celebrate over them and are glad, and they will send each other gifts, because these two prophets tortured those who live on the earth.
And after the three and a half days, a breath of life from God entered them, and they stood up on their feet, and great fear fell on those watching them.
And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them: Come up here. And they went up to heaven in the cloud, and their enemies watched them.
And at that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell, and seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake. And the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second woe has passed. Look — the third woe is coming quickly.
And the seventh angel blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven saying: The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign forever and ever.
And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshipped God,
saying: We thank you, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and begun to reign.

and the nations were angry, and your anger came, and the time for the dead to be judged, and to give the reward to your servants the prophets and to God's holy people and to those who fear your name, small and great, and to destroy those destroying the earth.
And the sanctuary of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was seen in his sanctuary. And there came flashes of lightning and rumblings and thunder and an earthquake and heavy hail.

revelation_12.t: Then a great sign appeared in the sky: a woman clothed with the sun, the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
She was pregnant, and she cries out in labour, in agony to give birth.
Then another sign appeared in the sky: a great fiery-red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.

His tail drags a third of the stars of the sky, and he threw them to the earth. And the dragon has stood before the woman who is about to give birth, so that when she gives birth he can devour her child.
And she bore a son, a male, who is going to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod. And her child was snatched away to God and to his throne.
And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has there a place prepared from God, so that there they would feed her one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
And there came war in heaven. Michael and his angels — to make war with the dragon; and the dragon made war, and his angels,
and he was not strong enough, nor was a place found for them any longer in heaven.

And the great dragon was thrown down — the ancient serpent, the one called Devil and the Satan, the one deceiving the whole inhabited world — he was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: 'Now has come the rescue and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ, because the accuser of our brothers and sisters was thrown down — the one accusing them before our God day and night.'
And they themselves conquered him through the blood of the Lamb and through the word of their testimony, and they did not love their life as far as death.
Because of this, be glad, you heavens and all who tent in them. Woe to those who inhabit the earth and the sea, because the devil went down to you having great rage, knowing that he has little time.
And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who bore the male.

And the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle, so that she could fly into the wilderness into her place, where she is fed there a time and times and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
And the serpent threw water like a river out of his mouth after the woman, so that he might make her river-carried — swept away in the flood.
And the earth helped the woman: the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river which the dragon threw out of his mouth.
And the dragon was enraged at the woman, and went off to make war with the rest of her seed — those who keep the commandments of God and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
And he stood on the sand of the sea.

revelation_13.t: And I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and on its horns ten royal crowns, and on its heads names of blasphemy.
And the beast I saw was like a leopard, and its feet like a bear's, and its mouth like a lion's mouth. And the dragon gave it his power and his throne and great authority.
And I saw one of its heads as though slaughtered to death, and the wound of its death was healed. And the whole earth was amazed and followed after the beast,
and they worshipped the dragon because he gave the authority to the beast, and they worshipped the beast, saying: 'Who is like the beast? And who is able to make war with it?'
And it was given a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies, and it was given authority to act for forty-two months.
And it opened its mouth in blasphemies toward God — to blaspheme his name and his tent, those who tent in heaven.
And it was given power to make war with God's holy ones and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and language and nation.
And all who inhabit the earth will worship it — everyone whose name has not been written from the founding of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who was slaughtered.
If anyone has an ear, let them hear.
If anyone gathers into captivity, into captivity he goes. If anyone by sword to be killed — he must by sword be killed. Here is the endurance and the trust of God's holy ones.
And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, and it spoke like a dragon.
And it does all the authority of the first beast in its presence, and it makes the earth and those who inhabit it worship the first beast, the one whose wound of its death was healed.
And it does great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth before people.

And it deceives those who inhabit the earth through the signs which were given to it to do before the beast — telling those who inhabit the earth to make an image for the beast who has the wound from the sword and lived.

And it was given power to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast could even speak, and could bring it about that all who do not worship the image of the beast are killed.
And it makes all — the small and the great, the rich and the poor, the free and the slaves — that they should give them a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
and so that no one can buy or sell except the one who has the mark — the name of the beast or the number of its name.
Here is the wisdom. Let the one who has the mind calculate the number of the beast, for it is a number of a human, and its number is six hundred and sixty-six.

revelation_14.t: Then I looked, and there was the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred and forty-four thousand, having his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads.
And I heard a sound out of heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of great thunder; and the sound I heard was like harpists harping on their harps.

And they sing what is like a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one could learn the song except the hundred and forty-four thousand, the ones purchased from the earth.

These are the ones who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were purchased from among humanity, a firstfruit to God and to the Lamb,
And no falsehood was found in their mouth; they are without blemish.
Then I saw another angel flying in mid-heaven, having an eternal good news to announce upon those who sit on the earth — upon every nation and tribe and language and people.
He said in a loud voice: 'Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgement has come. And worship the one who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.'
And another angel, a second, followed, saying: 'Fell, fell Babylon the great — she who made all the nations drink from the wine of the rage of her sexual immorality.'
And another angel, a third, followed them, saying in a loud voice: 'If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives a mark on their forehead or on their hand,
they too will drink of the wine of the rage of God, mixed unmixed in the cup of his wrath, and they will be tormented in fire and sulphur before the holy angels and before the Lamb.'
And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest day and night — those who worship the beast and its image, and anyone who receives the mark of its name.
Here is the endurance of God's holy ones, here — those who keep the commandments of God and their faith in Jesus.

Then I heard a voice out of heaven saying to me: 'Write: Blessed the dead who die in the Lord from now on.' 'Yes,' says the Spirit, 'so that they will rest from their labours, for their works follow with them.'
Then I looked, and there was a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden wreath and in his hand a sharp sickle.

And another angel came out of the sanctuary, crying in a loud voice to the one sitting on the cloud: 'Send your sickle and reap, because the hour to reap came for you, because the harvest of the earth was dried.'
And the one sitting on the cloud threw his sickle upon the earth, and the earth was reaped.
And another angel came out of the sanctuary that is in heaven, having, he too, a sharp sickle.

And another angel came out from the altar — the one who has authority over the fire — and he called in a loud voice to the one who had the sharp sickle: 'Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, because its grapes reached their peak.'
And the angel threw his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth, and threw it into the winepress of the rage of God, the great one.
And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress as far as the bridles of the horses, from one thousand six hundred stadia.

revelation_15.t: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous: seven angels having seven plagues, the last ones, because in them the rage of God was completed.
And I saw what was like a glassy sea mixed with fire, and those conquering out of the beast and out of its image and out of the number of its name, standing on the glassy sea, having harps of God.
And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God and the song of the Lamb: 'Great and marvellous are your works, Lord God the Almighty. Right and true are your ways, King of the nations.'
Who will not fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? Because you alone are holy; because all the nations will come and will worship before you; because your righteous acts were made visible.
And after this I looked, and the sanctuary of the tent of the witness in heaven was opened.
And the seven angels having the seven plagues came out of the sanctuary, clothed in clean bright linen and girded around the chest with golden sashes.
And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the rage of God, who lives into the ages of the ages.
And the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

revelation_16.t: Then I heard a loud voice out of the sanctuary saying to the seven angels: 'Go and pour out the seven bowls of the rage of God into the earth.'
So the first went off and poured out his bowl into the earth, and a bad and evil sore came upon the people who had the mark of the beast and worshipped its image.
And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead person, and every soul of life died — the things in the sea.
And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and into the springs of the waters, and it became blood.
And I heard the angel of the waters saying: 'Right are you, Lord — the one being and the one was and the holy one — because you judged these things,
because they poured out the blood of God's holy ones and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They are worthy.'
And I heard another out of the altar saying: 'Yes, Lord God the Almighty, true and right are your judgements.'
And the fourth angel poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was given to it to scorch people with fire.
And people were scorched a great scorching, and they blasphemed the name of God who has the authority over these plagues, and they did not change their mind to give him glory.
And the fifth angel poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became darkened, and they were chewing their tongues from the pain,
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and they did not change their mind about their works.
And the sixth angel poured out his bowl upon the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, so that the way might be prepared for the kings from the rising of the sun.
And I saw out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet three unclean spirits like frogs.
for they are spirits of demons doing signs, which go out to the kings of the earth and of the whole inhabited world, to gather them to the war of that great day of God the Almighty.
'Look, I come as a thief. Blessed the one who keeps watch and keeps his garments, so that he does not walk naked and they see his shame.'
And he gathered them into the place called in Hebrew Harmagedon.
And the seventh angel poured out his bowl upon the air, and a loud voice came out of the sanctuary of heaven, from the throne, saying: 'It has come to be.'
And there came lightnings and voices and thunders, and there came a great earthquake, such as had not come to be from when the humans came to be upon the earth — so great an earthquake, so great.
And the great city came to be into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And Babylon the great was remembered before God, to be given the cup of the wine of the rage of his wrath.
And every island fled, and the mountains were not found.
And great hail, about a talent in weight, comes down out of the sky upon people. And they blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, because its plague is exceedingly great.

revelation_17.t: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying to me: 'Come, I will show you the judgement of the great prostitute who sits on the many waters,'
with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and from the wine of her sexual immorality those who inhabit the earth were made drunk.
And he carried me away in spirit into a wilderness. And I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, gilded with gold and precious stone and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and the unclean things of her sexual immorality.
And on her forehead a name written: Mystery, Babylon the great, the mother of the prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.
And I saw the woman drunk from the blood of God's holy ones and from the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. And when I saw her I marvelled a great marvel.
And the angel said to me: 'Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, the one having the seven heads and the ten horns.'

The beast you saw was and is not, and is about to come up out of the abyss and goes off into destruction. And those who inhabit the earth will marvel — whose name has not been written upon the book of life from the founding of the world — when they see the beast, that it was and is not and will be present.
Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, where the woman sits on them — and they are seven kings.
The five fell, and the one is, the other has not yet come; and when he comes, he must remain a little.
And the beast which was and is not — it is itself an eighth and is of the seven, and goes off into destruction.
And the ten horns you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom, but who receive authority as kings for one hour with the beast.
These have one mind, and they give their power and their authority to the beast.
These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings — and those with him are called and chosen and faithful.
And he says to me: 'The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples and crowds and nations and languages.'
And the ten horns you saw, and the beast — these will hate the prostitute and will make her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her up with fire.
For God gave it into their hearts to do his mind — to be of one mind and to give their kingdom to the beast — until the words of God will be completed.
And the woman you saw is the great city that has a kingdom over the kings of the earth.

revelation_18.t: After this I saw another angel coming down out of heaven, having great authority, and the earth was lit up from his glory.

And he cried out with a strong voice, great, saying: 'Fell, fell Babylon the great! And she became a dwelling of demons, and a guard-house of every unclean spirit, and a guard-house of every unclean bird, and a guard-house of every unclean and hated beast,'

because from the wine of the rage of her sexual immorality all the nations have drunk, and the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the power of her luxury.
And I heard another voice out of heaven saying: 'Come out of her, my people, so that you do not share together in her sins, and so that you do not receive from her plagues;'
because her sins were glued together as far as heaven, and God remembered her wrongs.
Give back to her as she also gave back, and double to her the double things according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix for her double.
As much as she glorified herself and lived in luxury, so much give her torment and grief, because in her heart she says: 'I sit a queen, and I am not a widow, and I will certainly not see grief.'
Because of this in one day her plagues will come — death and grief and famine — and she will be burned up with fire, because strong is the Lord God who judged her.
And the kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her will weep and beat themselves over her, when they see the smoke of her burning,
standing far off because of the fear of her torment, saying: 'Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon the strong city! Because in one hour your judgement came.'
And the merchants of the earth weep and grieve over her, because no one buys their cargo any longer —

cargo of gold and silver and precious stone and pearls, of fine linen and purple and silk and scarlet; every citron wood and every ivory vessel and every vessel of most precious wood, and of bronze and iron and marble;
and cinnamon and spice and incense and ointment and frankincense, and wine and oil and fine flour and wheat, and cattle and sheep, and of horses and of carriages and of bodies — and souls of humans.
And the fruit of the desire of your soul went away from you, and all the fat things and the bright things perished from you, and they will certainly not find them any longer.
The merchants of these things, who grew rich from her, will stand far off because of the fear of her torment, weeping and grieving,
and saying: 'Woe, woe, the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and gilded with gold and precious stone and pearl!'
because in one hour so much wealth was made desolate. And every shipmaster and everyone sailing to a place, and the crowd, and sailors and as many as work the sea, stood far off
and they were crying out as they saw the smoke of her burning, saying: 'What is like the great city?'

And they threw dust on their heads and were crying out, weeping and grieving and saying: 'Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had the ships in the sea grew rich from her costliness! Because in one hour she was made desolate.'
Be glad over her, heaven, and the holy ones and the apostles and the prophets, because God judged your judgement out of her.
And one strong angel lifted a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying: 'So with violence will Babylon the great city be thrown, and will certainly not be found any longer.'

And the sound of harpers and musicians and flute-players and trumpeters will certainly not be heard in you any longer; and every craftsman of every craft will certainly not be found in you any longer; and the sound of a millstone will certainly not be heard in you any longer;

and the light of a lamp will certainly not shine in you any longer; and the voice of a bridegroom and a bride will certainly not be heard in you any longer — because your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because by your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
And in her was found the blood of prophets and of God's holy ones, and of all those slaughtered on the earth.

revelation_19.t: After this I heard what was like the great voice of a numerous crowd in heaven, saying: 'Hallelujah! The salvation and the glory and the honour and the power to the Lord of our God,'
because true and right are his judgements: because he judged the great prostitute who was corrupting the earth with her sexual immorality, and he avenged the blood of his servants out of her hand.
And a second time they have said: 'Hallelujah! And her smoke goes up into the ages of the ages.'
And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell and worshipped God who sits on the throne, saying: 'Amen. Hallelujah.'
And a voice came out from the throne saying: 'Praise our God, all his servants and you who fear him, the small and the great.'
And I heard what was like the voice of a numerous crowd, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of strong thunders, saying: 'Hallelujah! Because the Lord our God the Almighty reigned.'
Let us rejoice and exult and give the glory to him, because the wedding of the Lamb came, and his wife prepared herself.
And it was given to her that she should be clothed in fine linen, bright and clean — for the fine linen is the righteous acts of God's holy ones.
And he says to me: 'Write: Blessed those who are called to the supper of the wedding of the Lamb.' And he says to me: 'These are the true words of God.'

And I fell before his feet to worship him, and he says to me: 'See — no! I am your fellow servant, and of your brothers and sisters, those having, having the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of the prophecy.'
And I saw heaven opened, and look — a white horse, and the one sitting on it called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he judges and makes war;
and his eyes as a flame of fire, and on his head many royal crowns, having names written and a name written which no one knows except himself,
and clothed with a garment dipped in blood; and his name has been called the Word of God.
and the armies in heaven were following him on white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

And out of his mouth goes a sharp two-edged sword, so that with it he might strike the nations. And he himself will shepherd them with an iron rod, and he himself treads the winepress of the wine of the rage and the wrath of God the Almighty.
And he has on the garment and on his thigh a name written: King of kings and Lord of lords.
And I saw one angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice, saying to all the birds flying in mid-heaven: 'Come, be gathered to the great supper of God,'

so that you may eat fleshes of kings and fleshes of commanders and fleshes of strong ones, and fleshes of horses and of those sitting on them, and fleshes of all — both free and slaves, both small and great.
And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to make the war with the one sitting on the horse and with his army.

And the beast was seized, and with it the false prophet who did the signs before it, by which he deceived those who received the mark of the beast and those worshipping its image. Alive, the two were thrown into the lake of the fire that burns with sulphur.
And the rest were killed by the sword of the one sitting on the horse, the sword that came out of his mouth. And all the birds were filled from their fleshes.

revelation_20.t: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain upon his hand.
And he seized the dragon — the ancient serpent, who is Devil and the Satan, the one deceiving the whole inhabited world — and bound him a thousand years,

and he threw him into the abyss and shut and sealed above him, so that he would not deceive the nations any longer until the thousand years were completed. After these things he must be loosed a little time.

And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgement was given to them — and the souls of those beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and whoever did not worship the beast nor its image and did not receive the mark upon the forehead and upon their hand. And they came to life and reigned with the Christ the thousand years.
But the rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

Blessed and holy the one who has a part in the first resurrection. Over these the second death does not have authority, but they will be priests of God and of the Christ, and they will reign with him the thousand years.
And when the thousand years are completed, the Satan will be loosed out of his prison,
and he will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth — the Gog and the Magog — to gather them to the war, of whom their number is as the sand of the sea.
And they went up upon the breadth of the earth and encircled the camp of God's holy ones and the beloved city. And fire came down from God out of heaven and devoured them.
And the devil who deceives them was thrown into the lake of the fire and sulphur, where also the beast and the false prophet are, and they will be tormented day and night into the ages of the ages.
And I saw a great white throne and the one sitting upon it, from whose face the earth and heaven fled, and a place was not found for them.

And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. And another book was opened, which is the book of life. And the dead were judged out of the things written in the books, according to their works.
And the sea gave up the dead who were in it, and the Death and the Hades gave up the dead who were in them, and they were judged each according to their works.
And the Death and the Hades were thrown into the lake of the fire. This is the second death — the lake of the fire.
And if anyone was not found written in the book of life, they were thrown into the lake of the fire.

revelation_21.t: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth. For the first heaven and the first earth went away, and the sea is not any longer.
And I, John, saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

And I heard a loud voice out of the throne saying: 'Look — the tent of God with the humans! And he will tent with them, and they themselves will be his peoples, and he himself, God with them, will be their God.'
And God will wipe away every tear out of their eyes, and the death will not be any longer, nor grief nor crying, nor will pain not be any longer — because the first things went away.
And the one sitting on the throne said: 'Look — I make all things new.' And he says to me: 'Write, because these words are faithful and true.'
And he said to me: 'They have come to be. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the one thirsting I will give out of the spring of the water of life freely.'
The one conquering will inherit these things, and I will be God to them, and they themselves will be the son to me.

But to the cowardly and unbelieving and sinful and detestable, and murderers and the sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all the false ones — their part is in the lake burning with fire and sulphur, which is the second death.
And there came to me one of the seven angels having the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues, and he spoke with me saying: 'Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.'
And he carried me away in spirit onto a great and high mountain, and showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
having the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious stone, as a jasper stone, crystal-clear;
having a great and high wall, having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names inscribed, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel;
from the east three gates, and from the north three gates, and from the south three gates, and from the west three gates.
And the wall of the city having twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
And the one speaking with me had a measure, a golden reed, so that he might measure the city and its gates and its wall.
And the city lies four-square, and its length is as much as also its breadth. And he measured the city with the reed at twelve thousand stadia; its length and breadth and height are equal.
And he measured its wall, a hundred and forty-four cubits, a measure of a human, which is of an angel.
And the structure of its wall was jasper, and the city pure gold, like clear glass.
And the foundations of the wall of the city adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
And the twelve gates twelve pearls; each one of the gates was of one pearl. And the street of the city pure gold, like transparent glass.
And a sanctuary I did not see in it; for the Lord God the Almighty is its sanctuary — and the Lamb.
And the city has no need of the sun nor of the moon to shine in it; for the glory of God lit it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
And the nations of the saved will walk through its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory and their honour into it.
And its gates will certainly not be shut by day; for night will not be there.
And they will bring the glory and the honour of the nations into it.
And there will certainly not enter into it anything common, nor the one doing an abomination and a falsehood — except those written in the book of life of the Lamb.

revelation_22.t: And he showed me a clean river of water of life, bright as crystal, going out from the throne of God and of the Lamb.

In the middle of its street and of the river, on this side and on that, a tree of life producing twelve fruits, yielding its fruit each single month; and the leaves of the tree for the healing of the nations.
And every curse will not be any longer, and the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him,
and they will see his face, and his name on their foreheads.
And night will not be any longer, and they have no need of the light of a lamp and the light of the sun, because the Lord God will shine upon them. And they will reign into the ages of the ages.
And he said to me: 'These words are faithful and true. And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants the things which must come to be quickly.'
'And look, I come quickly. Blessed the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.'
And I, John, am the one hearing and seeing these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell to worship before the feet of the angel showing me these things.
And he says to me: 'See — no! For I am your fellow servant, and of your brothers and sisters the prophets, and of those keeping the words of this book. Worship God!'
And he says to me: 'Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this book, because, for the time is near.'
The one doing wrong, let him do wrong still; and the filthy one, let him be filthy still; and the right one, let him do rightness still; and the holy one, let him be made holy still.
'Look, I come quickly, and my wage is with me, to give back to each as their work is.'
'I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.'
Blessed those who wash their robes, so that their authority will be over the tree of life, and by the gates they may enter into the city.
Outside: the dogs and the sorcerers and the sexually immoral and the murderers and the idolaters, and everyone loving and doing falsehood.
'I, Jesus, sent my angel to testify these things to you upon the communities. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star.'
And the Spirit and the bride say: 'Come.' And let the one hearing say: 'Come.' And let the one thirsting come; let the one willing take the water of life freely.
'I testify, I myself, to everyone hearing the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds upon them, God will add upon them the plagues written in this book.'
'And if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away their part from the tree of life and out of the holy city, from the things written in this book.'
The one testifying these things says: 'Yes, I come quickly.' Amen. Yes — come, Lord Jesus.
The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.

romans_1.t: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called as an apostle, set apart for God's good news —
which he promised beforehand through his prophets in holy writings,
about his Son, who came from David's seed as far as the flesh goes,
and who was declared to be Son of God in power, according to a spirit of holiness, from the resurrection of the dead — Jesus Christ our Lord.
Through him we received grace and a sending out for the obedience of faith among all the nations, for the sake of his name —
and you're among them — called ones belonging to Jesus Christ —
to all in Rome who are loved by God, called as his holy people: grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
First — I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your trust is being announced all over the world.
God is my witness — the God I serve in my spirit, in the good news of his Son — how I never stop mentioning you,
always asking, in my prayers, whether somehow — now, at last — by God's will I may be given a clear road to come to you.
I'm longing to see you, so that I can share some spiritual gift with you, to make you firm —
or rather — that we may be encouraged together while I'm among you, each by the other's trust, yours and mine.

I don't want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, that I often planned to come to you — and was prevented until now — so that I might have some fruit among you too, as among the rest of the nations.
I'm in debt to Greeks and to barbarians, to the wise and to the unthinking.
So, for my part, I'm eager to announce the good news to you in Rome as well.
I'm not ashamed of the good news, because it is God's power for rescue to everyone who trusts — to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
For in it God's rightness is revealed, from trust to trust, as it is written: 'The one who is right from trust will live.'
For God's anger is being revealed from heaven against every irreverence and unrightness of people who hold the truth down in unrightness —
because what can be known of God is plain among them — God made it plain to them.
Ever since the creation of the world his unseeable things — his everlasting power and divinity — have been clearly seen, understood through the things he made, so that they have no defence.
For though they knew God, they didn't honour him as God or thank him. Instead they became futile in their reasonings, and their uncomprehending heart was darkened.
Claiming to be wise, they were made fools;
and they exchanged the glory of the imperishable God for a likeness of an image of perishable humanity — and of birds and four-footed animals and creeping things.
So God handed them over, in the desires of their hearts, to uncleanness — to the dishonouring of their bodies among themselves.
They exchanged the truth of God for the lie, and revered and served what was created rather than the Creator — who is blessed for ever. Amen.
Because of this, God handed them over to passions of dishonour: their females exchanged the natural use for the one contrary to nature,

and likewise the males too, leaving the natural use of the female, were inflamed in their craving for one another — males with males working out the indecency, and receiving back in themselves the payment their straying required.
And since they did not think it worth approving to keep God in their knowledge, God handed them over to an unapproved mind, to do what is not fitting —
filled with every kind of unrightness, sexual immorality, wickedness, greed, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, spite; whisperers,
slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant, boasters, inventors of evils, disobedient to parents,
senseless, promise-breaking, heartless, unforgiving, merciless.
They recognise God's just decree — that those who practise such things deserve death — and they don't just do them, they applaud those who practise them.

romans_2.t: So you have no defence — whoever you are, you who judge. When you judge someone else you condemn yourself, because you, the judge, practise the same things.
And we know that God's judgement is according to truth against those who practise such things.
Do you reckon this — you who judge those who practise such things and do them yourself — that you'll escape God's judgement?
Or do you look down on the wealth of his kindness, his forbearance, his patience — not realising that God's kindness is leading you to a change of mind?
But with your hardness, your unchanged heart, you're storing up anger for yourself — for a day of anger, when God's just judgement is revealed —
He will pay back to each according to his works:
to those who by endurance in good work seek glory and honour and imperishability — eternal life;
but to those who act out of rivalry, and disobey the truth while obeying unrightness — anger and fury.
Trouble and constriction on every human being who works out evil — the Jew first and also the Greek;
but glory and honour and peace to everyone who works the good — the Jew first and also the Greek.
For God shows no favouritism.
All who sinned outside law will also perish outside law, and all who sinned under law will be judged through law.
For it's not the hearers of law who are right before God — it's the doers of law who will be justified.
For whenever nations that do not have law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having law, are a law to themselves.
They show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their reasonings among one another accusing or even defending them —
on a day when God judges the hidden things of people through Christ Jesus, according to my good news.
But if you call yourself a Jew and rest on law and boast in God
and know the will and approve the things that matter, being instructed out of the law,
and are convinced that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light for those in darkness,
a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of infants, having in the law the outline of knowledge and of truth —
you, then, who teach someone else — don't you teach yourself? You who proclaim not to steal — do you steal?
You who say not to commit adultery — do you commit adultery? You who detest idols — do you rob temples?
You who boast in law — through breaking the law do you dishonour God?
For 'the name of God is blasphemed among the nations because of you', as it is written.
Circumcision is of benefit if you practise law. But if you're a law-breaker, your circumcision has become foreskin.
So if the foreskin keeps the just requirements of the law, won't his foreskin be reckoned as circumcision?
And the one uncircumcised by birth, by completing the law, will judge you who — with letter and circumcision — are a law-breaker.
For the Jew is not the one who is so in the open, nor is circumcision the one in the open, in flesh;
but the Jew is the one hidden, and circumcision is of the heart, in spirit not in letter — whose praise comes not from people but from God.

romans_3.t: So what's the advantage of the Jew, then? What's the benefit of circumcision?
Much — in every way. First of all: they were entrusted with the sayings of God.
So what if some were unfaithful? Their unfaithfulness won't cancel God's faithfulness, will it?
Absolutely not. Let God be true and every person a liar, as it is written: 'So that you may be justified in your words and will win when you are judged.'
But if our unrightness demonstrates God's rightness, what shall we say? Is God unjust to bring the anger? (I'm speaking in human terms.)
Absolutely not — since then how will God judge the world?
But if God's truth abounded to his glory by my lie — why am I still judged as a sinner?
And why not say — as we are slandered as saying, and as some claim we say — 'Let us do the evil things so that the good may come'? Their judgement is deserved.
What then? Are we better off? Not at all. For we've already charged that all — Jews and Greeks alike — are under sin,
as it is written: 'There is no one right, not even one;
there is no one who understands, there is no one who seeks out God.
All turned away, together they became useless; there is no one doing kindness, there is not so much as one.
Their throat is an opened grave; with their tongues they kept deceiving; venom of asps is under their lips;
their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.
Their feet are swift to pour out blood;
ruin and misery are in their ways,
and the way of peace they did not know.
There is no fear of God before their eyes.'
Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those under the law, so that every mouth may be stopped and the whole world become answerable to God —
because by works of the law no flesh will be justified before him; for through law comes recognition of sin.
But now, apart from law, God's rightness has been made visible — testified to by the law and the prophets —
God's rightness through faith in Jesus Christ, to all and on all who trust. For there is no distinction:
for all sinned and are falling short of the glory of God,
being justified freely by his grace, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus —
whom God set forth as a propitiation through trust, in his blood, as a demonstration of his rightness — because of the passing over of the sins committed beforehand, in the forbearance of God —
